verses.sa:
सत्यं बृहदृतमुग्रं दीक्षा तपो ब्रह्म यज्ञः पृथिवीं धारयन्ति ।
सा नो भूतस्य भव्यस्य पत्न्युरुं लोकं पृथिवी नः कृणोतु ॥
verses.rom:
satyam brihadritamugram diksha tapo brahma yajnah prithivim dharayanti |
sa no bhutasya bhavyasya patnyurum lokam prithivi nah krinotu ||
verses.en: Great (bṛhánt) truth, formidable right, consecration, penance, bráhman, sacrifice sustain the earth; let her for us, mistress of what is and what is to be—let the earth make for us wide room (loká);—

verses.sa:
असंबाधं मध्यतो मानवानां यस्या उद्वतः प्रवतः समं बहु ।
नानावीर्या ओषधीर्या बिभर्ति पृथिवी नः प्रथतां राध्यतां नः ॥
verses.rom:
asambadham madhyato manavanam yasya udvatah pravatah samam bahu |
nanavirya oshadhirya bibharti prithivi nah prathatam radhyatam nah ||
verses.en: Unoppressedness in the midst of men (mānavá). Whose are the ascents (udvát), the advances (pravát), the much plain (samá); who bears the herbs of various virtue (nā́nāvīrya)—let the earth be spread out for us, be prosperous for us.

verses.sa:
यस्यां समुद्र उत सिन्धुरापो यस्यामन्नं कृष्टयः संबभूवुः ।
यस्यामिदं जिन्वति प्राणदेजत्सा नो भूमिः पूर्वपेये दधातु ॥
verses.rom:
yasyam samudra uta sindhurapo yasyamannam krishtayah sambabhuvuh |
yasyamidam jinvati pranadejatsa no bhumih purvapeye dadhatu ||
verses.en: On whom [are] the ocean and the river (síndhu), the waters; on whom food, plowings, came into being; on whom quickens this that breathes, that stirs—let that earth (bhū́mi) set us in first drinking.

verses.sa:
यस्याश्चतस्रः प्रदिशः पृथिव्या यस्यामन्नं कृष्टयः संबभूवुः ।
या बिभर्ति बहुधा प्राणदेजत्सा नो भूमिर्गोष्वप्यन्ने दधातु ॥
verses.rom:
yasyashchatasrah pradishah prithivya yasyamannam krishtayah sambabhuvuh |
ya bibharti bahudha pranadejatsa no bhumirgoshvapyanne dadhatu ||
verses.en: Whose, the earth's, [are] the four quarters; on whom food, plowings, came into being; who bears manifoldly what breathes, what stirs—let that earth (bhū́mi) set us among kine, also in inexhaustibleness (? ánya).

verses.sa:
यस्यां पूर्वे पूर्वजना विचक्रिरे यस्यां देवा असुरान् अभ्यवर्तयन् ।
गवामश्वानां वयसश्च विष्ठा भगं वर्चः पृथिवी नो दधातु ॥
verses.rom:
yasyam purve purvajana vichakrire yasyam deva asuran abhyavartayan |
gavamashvanam vayasashcha vishtha bhagam varchah prithivi no dadhatu ||
verses.en: On whom the people of eld (pūrvajaná) formerly spread themselves (? vi-kṛ); on whom the gods overcame the Asuras; the station (? viṣṭhā́) of kine, of horses, of birds (váyas)—let the earth assign us fortune (bhága), splendor.

verses.sa:
विश्वंभरा वसुधानी प्रतिष्ठा हिरण्यवक्षा जगतो निवेशनी ।
वैश्वानरं बिभ्रती भूमिरग्निमिन्द्रऋषभा द्रविणे नो दधातु ॥
verses.rom:
vishvambhara vasudhani pratishtha hiranyavaksha jagato niveshani |
vaishvanaram bibhrati bhumiragnimindrarishabha dravine no dadhatu ||
verses.en: All-bearing, good-holding, firm-standing, gold-backed (-vákṣas), reposer of moving things (jágat), bearing the universal (vāiçvānará) fire, let the earth (bhū́mi), whose bull is Indra, set us in property.

verses.sa:
यां रक्षन्त्यस्वप्ना विश्वदानीं देवा भूमिं पृथिवीमप्रमादम् ।
सा नो मधु प्रियं दुहामथो उक्षतु वर्चसा ॥
verses.rom:
yam rakshantyasvapna vishvadanim deva bhumim prithivimapramadam |
sa no madhu priyam duhamatho ukshatu varchasa ||
verses.en: She the earth (bhū́mi pṛthivī́), whom the gods, sleepless, defend all the time without failure—let her yield (duh) to us honey, what is dear; then let her sprinkle us with splendor.

verses.sa:
यार्णवेऽधि सलिलमग्र आसीत्यां मायाभिरन्वचरन् मनीषिणः ।
यस्या हृदयं परमे व्योमन्त्सत्येनावृतममृतं पृथिव्याः ।
सा नो भूमिस्त्विषिं बलं राष्ट्रे दधातूत्तमे ॥
verses.rom:
yarnave'dhi salilamagra asityam mayabhiranvacharan manishinah |
yasya hridayam parame vyomantsatyenavritamamritam prithivyah |
sa no bhumistvishim balam rashtre dadhatuttame ||
verses.en: She who in the beginning was sea (salilá) upon the ocean (arṇavá); whom the skilful (manīṣín) moved after with their devices (māyā́); the earth whose immortal heart covered with truth is in the highest firmament (vyòman)—let that earth (bhū́mi) assign to us brilliancy, strength, in highest royalty.

verses.sa:
यस्यामापः परिचराः समानीरहोरात्रे अप्रमादं क्षरन्ति ।
सा नो भूमिर्भूरिधारा पयो दुहामथो उक्षतु वर्चसा ॥
verses.rom:
yasyamapah paricharah samanirahoratre apramadam ksharanti |
sa no bhumirbhuridhara payo duhamatho ukshatu varchasa ||
verses.en: On whom the circulating waters flow the same, night and day, without failure—let that earth (bhū́mi), of many streams (-dhā́rā) yield (duh) us milk; then let her sprinkle [us] with splendor.

verses.sa:
यामश्विनावमिमातां विष्णुर्यस्यां विचक्रमे ।
इन्द्रो यां चक्र आत्मनेऽनमित्रां शचीपतिः ।
सा नो भूमिर्वि सृजतां माता पुत्राय मे पयः ॥
verses.rom:
yamashvinavamimatam vishnuryasyam vichakrame |
indro yam chakra atmane'namitram shachipatih |
sa no bhumirvi srijatam mata putraya me payah ||
verses.en: Whom the Açvins measured; on whom Vishṇu strode out; whom Indra, lord of might (çacī-), made free from enemies for himself—let that earth (bhū́mi) to us, a mother to a son, release (vi-sṛj) milk to me.

verses.sa:
गिरयस्ते पर्वता हिमवन्तोऽरण्यं ते पृथिवि स्योनमस्तु ।
बभ्रुं कृष्णां रोहिणीं विश्वरूपां ध्रुवां भूमिं पृथिवीमिन्द्रगुप्ताम् ।
अजीतोऽहतो अक्षतोऽध्यष्ठां पृथिवीमहम् ॥
verses.rom:
girayaste parvata himavanto'ranyam te prithivi syonamastu |
babhrum krishnam rohinim vishvarupam dhruvam bhumim prithivimindraguptam |
ajito'hato akshato'dhyashtham prithivimaham ||
verses.en: Let thy hills (girí) [and] snowy mountains (párvata), let thy forest-land (áraṇya), O earth, be pleasant (syoná); upon the brown, black, red, all-formed, fixed (dhruvá) earth (bhū́mi), the earth guarded by Indra—I, unharassed, unsmitten, unwounded, have stood upon the earth.

verses.sa:
यत्ते मध्यं पृथिवि यच्च नभ्यं यास्त ऊर्जस्तन्वः संबभूवुः ।
तासु नो धेह्यभि नः पवस्व माता भूमिः पुत्रो अहं पृथिव्याः पर्जन्यः पिता स उ नः पिपर्तु ॥
verses.rom:
yatte madhyam prithivi yachcha nabhyam yasta urjastanvah sambabhuvuh |
tasu no dhehyabhi nah pavasva mata bhumih putro aham prithivyah parjanyah pita sa u nah pipartu ||
verses.en: What is thy middle, O earth, and what thy navel, what refreshments (ū́rj) arose (sam-bhū) out of thy body—in them do thou set us; be purifying (pū) toward us; earth (bhū́mi) is mother, I am earth's son; Parjanya is father—let him save (fill? pṛ) us.

verses.sa:
यस्यां वेदिं परिगृह्णन्ति भूम्यां यस्यां यज्ञं तन्वते विश्वकर्माणः ।
यस्यां मीयन्ते स्वरवः पृथिव्यामूर्ध्वाः शुक्रा आहुत्याः पुरस्तात्।
सा नो भूमिर्वर्धयद्वर्धमाना ॥
verses.rom:
yasyam vedim parigrihnanti bhumyam yasyam yajnam tanvate vishvakarmanah |
yasyam miyante svaravah prithivyamurdhvah shukra ahutyah purastat|
sa no bhumirvardhayadvardhamana ||
verses.en: On what earth (bhū́mi) they enclose the sacrificial hearth; on what [earth] men of all works extend the sacrifice; on what earth are set up (mi) the sacrificial posts, erect, bright, before the oblation—let that earth (bhū́mi), increasing, make us increase.

verses.sa:
यो नो द्वेषत्पृथिवि यः पृतन्याद्योऽभिदासान् मनसा यो वधेन ।
तं नो भूमे रन्धय पूर्वकृत्वरि ॥
verses.rom:
yo no dveshatprithivi yah pritanyadyo'bhidasan manasa yo vadhena |
tam no bhume randhaya purvakritvari ||
verses.en: Whoso shall hate us, O earth; whoso shall fight [us]; whoso shall vex [us] with mind, who with deadly weapon—him, O prior-acting earth (bhū́mi), do thou put in our power.

verses.sa:
त्वज्जातास्त्वयि चरन्ति मर्त्यास्त्वं बिभर्षि द्विपदस्त्वं चतुष्पदः ।
तवेमे पृथिवि पञ्च मानवा येभ्यो ज्योतिरमृतं मर्त्येभ्य उद्यन्त्सूर्यो रश्मिभिरातनोति ॥
verses.rom:
tvajjatastvayi charanti martyastvam bibharshi dvipadastvam chatushpadah |
taveme prithivi pancha manava yebhyo jyotiramritam martyebhya udyantsuryo rashmibhiratanoti ||
verses.en: Born from thee, mortals go about upon thee; thou bearest bipeds, thou quadrupeds; thine, O earth, are these five [races] of men, for whom, mortals, the rising sun extends with his rays immortal light.

verses.sa: ता नः प्रजाः सं दुह्रतां समग्रा वाचो मधु पृथिवि धेहि मह्यम् ॥
verses.rom: ta nah prajah sam duhratam samagra vacho madhu prithivi dhehi mahyam ||
verses.en: Let those creatures, without exception (samagrá), together yield fruit (duh) to us; the honey of speech, O earth, do thou assign unto me.

verses.sa:
विश्वस्वं मातरमोषधीनां ध्रुवां भूमिं पृथिवीं धर्मणा धृताम् ।
शिवां स्योनामनु चरेम विश्वहा ॥
verses.rom:
vishvasvam mataramoshadhinam dhruvam bhumim prithivim dharmana dhritam |
shivam syonamanu charema vishvaha ||
verses.en: The all-producing (-sū́) mother of herbs, the fixed earth (bhū́mi), the earth maintained by ordinance, the auspicious, the pleasant, may we go about over always.

verses.sa:
महत्सधस्थं महती बभूविथ महान् वेग एजथुर्वेपथुष्टे ।
महांस्त्वेन्द्रो रक्षत्यप्रमादम् ।
सा नो भूमे प्र रोचय हिरण्यस्येव संदृशि मा नो द्विक्षत कश्चन ॥
verses.rom:
mahatsadhastham mahati babhuvitha mahan vega ejathurvepathushte |
mahamstvendro rakshatyapramadam |
sa no bhume pra rochaya hiranyasyeva samdrishi ma no dvikshata kashchana ||
verses.en: Thou hast become great, a great station (sadhástha) great is thy trembling, stirring, quaking; great Indra defends thee unremittingly. Do thou, O earth (bhū́mi), make us to shine forth as in the aspect (saṁdṛ́ç) of gold; let no one soever hate us.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्भूम्यामोषधीष्वग्निमापो बिभ्रत्यग्निरश्मसु ।
अग्निरन्तः पुरुषेषु गोष्वश्वेष्वग्नयः ॥
verses.rom:
agnirbhumyamoshadhishvagnimapo bibhratyagnirashmasu |
agnirantah purusheshu goshvashveshvagnayah ||
verses.en: Agni is in the earth (bhū́mi), in the herbs; the waters bear Agni; Agni [is] in the stones (áçman); Agni is within men; in kine, in horses are Agnis.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्दिव आ तपत्यग्नेर्देवस्योर्वन्तरिक्षम् ।
अग्निं मर्तास इन्धते हव्यवाहं घृतप्रियम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnirdiva a tapatyagnerdevasyorvantariksham |
agnim martasa indhate havyavaham ghritapriyam ||
verses.en: Agni sends heat from the sky; the wide atmosphere is god Agni's; mortals kindle Agni [as] oblation-bearer, ghee-lover.

verses.sa: अग्निवासाः पृथिव्यसितज्ञूस्त्विषीमन्तं संशितं मा कृणोतु ॥
verses.rom: agnivasah prithivyasitajnustvishimantam samshitam ma krinotu ||
verses.en: Let the earth, fire-clad, black-kneed, make me sharpened, brilliant (tvíṣīmant).

verses.sa:
भूम्यां देवेभ्यो ददति यज्ञं हव्यमरंकृतम् ।
भूम्यां मनुष्या जीवन्ति स्वधयान्नेन मर्त्याः ।
सा नो भूमिः प्राणमायुर्दधातु जरदष्टिं मा पृथिवी कृणोतु ॥
verses.rom:
bhumyam devebhyo dadati yajnam havyamaramkritam |
bhumyam manushya jivanti svadhayannena martyah |
sa no bhumih pranamayurdadhatu jaradashtim ma prithivi krinotu ||
verses.en: On the earth (bhū́mi) they give to the gods the sacrifice, the oblation, duly prepared; on the earth (bhū́mi) mortal men (manuṣyà) live by svadhā́, by food; let that earth (bhū́mi) assign us breath, life-time; let earth make me one who attains old age.

verses.sa:
यस्ते गन्धः पृथिवि संबभूव यं बिभ्रत्योषधयो यमापः ।
यं गन्धर्वा अप्सरसश्च भेजिरे तेन मा सुरभिं कृणु मा नो द्विक्षत कश्चन ॥
verses.rom:
yaste gandhah prithivi sambabhuva yam bibhratyoshadhayo yamapah |
yam gandharva apsarasashcha bhejire tena ma surabhim krinu ma no dvikshata kashchana ||
verses.en: What odor of thine, O earth, came into being, which the herbs, which the waters bear, which the Gandharvas and Apsarases shared—with that do thou make me odorous; let no one soever hate us.

verses.sa:
यस्ते गन्धः पुष्करमाविवेश यं संजभ्रुः सूर्याया विवाहे ।
अमर्त्याः पृथिवि गन्धमग्रे तेन मा सुरभिं कृणु मा नो द्विक्षत कश्चन ॥
verses.rom:
yaste gandhah pushkaramavivesha yam samjabhruh suryaya vivahe |
amartyah prithivi gandhamagre tena ma surabhim krinu ma no dvikshata kashchana ||
verses.en: What odor of thine entered into the blue lotus; which they brought together at Sūryā's wedding—the immortals, O earth, [what] odor in the beginning—with that do thou make me odorous; let no one soever hate us.

verses.sa:
यस्ते गन्धः पुरुषेषु स्त्रीषु पुंसु भगो रुचिः ।
यो अश्वेषु वीरेषु यो मृगेषूत हस्तिषु ।
कन्यायां वर्चो यद्भूमे तेनास्माँ अपि सं सृज मा नो द्विक्षत कश्चन ॥
verses.rom:
yaste gandhah purusheshu strishu pumsu bhago ruchih |
yo ashveshu vireshu yo mrigeshuta hastishu |
kanyayam varcho yadbhume tenasman api sam srija ma no dvikshata kashchana ||
verses.en: What odor of thine is in human beings (púruṣa); in women, in men, [what] portion, pleasure; what in horses, in heroes, what in wild animals and in elephants; what splendor, O earth (bhū́mi), in a maiden—with that do thou unite us also; let no one soever hate us.

verses.sa:
शिला भूमिरश्मा पांसुः सा भूमिः संधृता धृता ।
तस्यै हिरण्यवक्षसे पृथिव्या अकरं नमः ॥
verses.rom:
shila bhumirashma pamsuh sa bhumih samdhrita dhrita |
tasyai hiranyavakshase prithivya akaram namah ||
verses.en: Rock [is?] earth (bhū́mi), stone, dust; this earth (bhū́mi) [is] held together, held; to that earth, gold-backed (-vákṣas) have I paid homage.

verses.sa:
यस्यां वृक्षा वानस्पत्या ध्रुवास्तिष्ठन्ति विश्वहा ।
पृथिवीं विश्वधायसं धृतामछावदामसि ॥
verses.rom:
yasyam vriksha vanaspatya dhruvastishthanti vishvaha |
prithivim vishvadhayasam dhritamachhavadamasi ||
verses.en: On whom stand always fixed the trees, the forest trees (vānaspatyá), the all-supporting earth that is held [together] do we address.

verses.sa:
उदीराणा उतासीनास्तिष्ठन्तः प्रक्रामन्तः ।
पद्भ्यां दक्षिणसव्याभ्यां मा व्यथिष्महि भूम्याम् ॥
verses.rom:
udirana utasinastishthantah prakramantah |
padbhyam dakshinasavyabhyam ma vyathishmahi bhumyam ||
verses.en: Arising (ud-īr), also sitting, standing, striding forth, with right and left feet, let us not stagger upon the earth.

verses.sa:
विमृग्वरीं पृथिवीमा वदामि क्षमां भूमिं ब्रह्मणा वावृधानाम् ।
ऊर्जं पुष्टं बिभ्रतीमन्नभागं घृतं त्वाभि नि षीदेम भूमे ॥
verses.rom:
vimrigvarim prithivima vadami kshamam bhumim brahmana vavridhanam |
urjam pushtam bibhratimannabhagam ghritam tvabhi ni shidema bhume ||
verses.en: The cleansing (vimṛ́gvan) earth do I address, the patient (kṣamá) earth (bhū́mi), increasing by worship (bráhman); may we sit down, O earth (bhū́mi), upon thee, that bearest refreshment, prosperity (puṣṭá), food-portion, ghee.

verses.sa:
शुद्धा न आपस्तन्वे क्षरन्तु यो नः सेदुरप्रिये तं नि दध्मः ।
पवित्रेण पृथिवि मोत्पुनामि ॥
verses.rom:
shuddha na apastanve ksharantu yo nah sedurapriye tam ni dadhmah |
pavitrena prithivi motpunami ||
verses.en: Let cleansed (çuddhá) waters flow for our body; what mucus (? syédu) is ours, that we deposit on him we love not (ápriya); with a purifier (pavítra), O earth, do I purify myself.

verses.sa:
यास्ते प्राचीः प्रदिशो या उदीचीर्यास्ते भूमे अधराद्याश्च पश्चात्।
स्योनास्ता मह्यं चरते भवन्तु मा नि पप्तं भुवने शिश्रियाणः ॥
verses.rom:
yaste prachih pradisho ya udichiryaste bhume adharadyashcha pashchat|
syonasta mahyam charate bhavantu ma ni paptam bhuvane shishriyanah ||
verses.en: What forward directions are thine, what upward, what are thine, O earth (bhū́mi), downward, and what behind, let those be pleasant to me going about; let me not fall down [when] supported (çri) on creation (bhúvana).

verses.sa:
मा नः पश्चान् मा पुरस्तान् नुदिष्ठा मोत्तरादधरादुत ।
स्वस्ति भूमे नो भव मा विदन् परिपन्थिनो वरीयो यावया वधम् ॥
verses.rom:
ma nah pashchan ma purastan nudishtha mottaradadharaduta |
svasti bhume no bhava ma vidan paripanthino variyo yavaya vadham ||
verses.en: Do not push (nud) us behind, nor in front, nor above and below; become thou welfare for us, O earth (bhū́mi); let not the waylayers find [us]; keep very far off the deadly weapon.

verses.sa:
यावत्तेऽभि विपश्यामि भूमे सूर्येण मेदिना ।
तावन् मे चक्षुर्मा मेष्टोत्तरामुत्तरां समाम् ॥
verses.rom:
yavatte'bhi vipashyami bhume suryena medina |
tavan me chakshurma meshtottaramuttaram samam ||
verses.en: How much of thee I look forth upon, O earth (bhū́mi), with the sun for ally (medín), so far let my sight not fail (mī), from one year (sámā) to another.

verses.sa:
यच्छयानः पर्यावर्ते दक्षिणं सख्यमभि भूमे पार्श्वमुत्तानास्त्वा प्रतीचीं यत्पृष्टीभिरधिशेमहे ।
मा हिंसीस्तत्र नो भूमे सर्वस्य प्रतिशीवरि ॥
verses.rom:
yachchhayanah paryavarte dakshinam sakhyamabhi bhume parshvamuttanastva pratichim yatprishtibhiradhishemahe |
ma himsistatra no bhume sarvasya pratishivari ||
verses.en: In that, lying, I turn myself about upon the right [or] the left side, O earth (bhū́mi); in that we with our ribs lie stretched out upon thee that meetest us—do not in that case injure us, O earth (bhū́mi), thou underlier of everything.

verses.sa:
यत्ते भूमे विखनामि क्षिप्रं तदपि रोहतु ।
मा ते मर्म विमृग्वरि मा ते हृदयमर्पिपम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatte bhume vikhanami kshipram tadapi rohatu |
ma te marma vimrigvari ma te hridayamarpipam ||
verses.en: What of thee, O earth (bhū́mi), I dig out, let that quickly grow over; let me not hit (arpay-) thy vitals nor thy heart, O cleansing one.

verses.sa:
ग्रीष्मस्ते भूमे वर्षाणि शरद्धेमन्तः शिशिरो वसन्तः ।
ऋतवस्ते विहिता हायनीरहोरात्रे पृथिवि नो दुहाताम् ॥
verses.rom:
grishmaste bhume varshani sharaddhemantah shishiro vasantah |
ritavaste vihita hayanirahoratre prithivi no duhatam ||
verses.en: Let thy hot season, O earth (bhū́mi), rainy season, autumn, winter, cool season, spring—let thine arranged seasons, years, let day-and-night, O earth, yield milk (duh) to us.

verses.sa:
याप सर्पं विजमाना विमृग्वरी यस्यामासन्न् अग्नयो ये अप्स्वन्तः ।
परा दस्यून् ददती देवपीयून् इन्द्रं वृणाना पृथिवी न वृत्रं शक्राय दध्रे वृषभाय वृष्णे ॥
verses.rom:
yapa sarpam vijamana vimrigvari yasyamasann agnayo ye apsvantah |
para dasyun dadati devapiyun indram vrinana prithivi na vritram shakraya dadhre vrishabhaya vrishne ||
verses.en: She who, cleansing one, trembling away the serpent; on whom were the fires that are within the waters, abandoning the god-insulting barbarians, choosing, she the earth, Indra [and] not Vṛitra, kept herself (dhṛ) for the mighty one (çakrá), the virile bull.

verses.sa:
यस्यां सदोहविर्धाने यूपो यस्यां निमीयते ।
ब्रह्माणो यस्यामर्चन्त्यृग्भिः साम्ना यजुर्विदः युज्यन्ते यस्यामृत्विजः सोममिन्द्राय पातवे ॥
verses.rom:
yasyam sadohavirdhane yupo yasyam nimiyate |
brahmano yasyamarchantyrigbhih samna yajurvidah yujyante yasyamritvijah somamindraya patave ||
verses.en: On whom are the seat and oblation-holder; on whom the sacrificial post (yū́pa) is planted; on whom worshipers (brahmán) praise (arc) with verses, with the chant, knowing the sacrificial formulas; on whom are joined the priests (ṛtvíj), for Indra to drink the soma;—

verses.sa:
यस्यां पूर्वे भूतकृत ऋषयो गा उदानृचुः ।
सप्त सत्रेण वेधसो यज्ञेन तपसा सह ॥
verses.rom:
yasyam purve bhutakrita rishayo ga udanrichuh |
sapta satrena vedhaso yajnena tapasa saha ||
verses.en: On whom the former being-making seers sang out (ud-arc) the kine—the seven pious ones (vedhás), by their session, together with sacrifice [and] penance;—

verses.sa:
सा नो भूमिरा दिशतु यद्धनं कामयामहे ।
भगो अनुप्रयुङ्क्तामिन्द्र एतु पुरोगवः ॥
verses.rom:
sa no bhumira dishatu yaddhanam kamayamahe |
bhago anuprayunktamindra etu purogavah ||
verses.en: Let that earth (bhū́mi) appoint unto us what riches we desire; let Bhaga join on after; let Indra go [as our] forerunner.

verses.sa:
यस्यां गायन्ति नृत्यन्ति भूम्यां मर्त्या व्यैलबाः ।
युध्यन्ते यस्यामाक्रन्दो यस्यां वदति दुन्दुभिः ।
सा नो भूमिः प्र णुदतां सपत्नान् असपत्नं मा पृथिवी कृणोतु ॥
verses.rom:
yasyam gayanti nrityanti bhumyam martya vyailabah |
yudhyante yasyamakrando yasyam vadati dundubhih |
sa no bhumih pra nudatam sapatnan asapatnam ma prithivi krinotu ||
verses.en: On whom, the earth (bhū́mi), mortals sing [and] dance with loud noises (? vyāìlaba); on whom they fight; on whom speaks the shout (ākrandá), the drum—let that earth (bhū́mi) push forth our rivals; let earth make me free from rivals.

verses.sa:
यस्यामन्नं व्रीहियवौ यस्या इमाः पञ्च कृष्टयः ।
भूम्यै पर्जन्यपत्न्यै नमोऽस्तु वर्षमेदसे ॥
verses.rom:
yasyamannam vrihiyavau yasya imah pancha krishtayah |
bhumyai parjanyapatnyai namo'stu varshamedase ||
verses.en: On whom is food, rice-and-barley; whose are these five races (kṛṣṭí)—to the earth, whose spouse is Parjanya, fattened (-médas) by the rain, be homage.

verses.sa:
यस्याः पुरो देवकृताः क्षेत्रे यस्या विकुर्वते ।
प्रजापतिः पृथिवीं विश्वगर्भामाशामाशां रण्यां नः कृणोतु ॥
verses.rom:
yasyah puro devakritah kshetre yasya vikurvate |
prajapatih prithivim vishvagarbhamashamasham ranyam nah krinotu ||
verses.en: Whose are the god-made strongholds; in whose field [men] fall out (? vi-kṛ)—the earth, womb of everything, let Prajāpati make pleasant (ráṇya) to us, spot by spot.

verses.sa:
निधिं बिभ्रती बहुधा गुहा वसु मणिं हिरण्यं पृथिवी ददातु मे ।
वसूनि नो वसुदा रासमाना देवी दधातु सुमनस्यमाना ॥
verses.rom:
nidhim bibhrati bahudha guha vasu manim hiranyam prithivi dadatu me |
vasuni no vasuda rasamana devi dadhatu sumanasyamana ||
verses.en: Bearing treasure [and] good in many places hiddenly, let the earth give me jewel (maṇí), gold; giver of good, bestowing good things on us, let the divine one assign [them to us] with favoring mind.

verses.sa:
जनं बिभ्रती बहुधा विवाचसं नानाधर्माणं पृथिवी यथौकसम् ।
सहस्रं धारा द्रविणस्य मे दुहां ध्रुवेव धेनुरनपस्फुरन्ती ॥
verses.rom:
janam bibhrati bahudha vivachasam nanadharmanam prithivi yathaukasam |
sahasram dhara dravinasya me duham dhruveva dhenuranapasphuranti ||
verses.en: Let the earth, bearing in many places people of different speech, of diverse customs (-dhárman), according to their homes, yield (duh) me a thousand streams of property, like a steady (dhruvá) unresisting milch-cow.

verses.sa:
यस्ते सर्पो वृश्चिकस्तृष्टदंश्मा हेमन्तजब्धो भृमलो गुहा शये ।
क्रिमिर्जिन्वत्पृथिवि यद्यदेजति प्रावृषि तन् नः सर्पन् मोप सृपद्यच्छिवं तेन नो मृड ॥
verses.rom:
yaste sarpo vrishchikastrishtadamshma hemantajabdho bhrimalo guha shaye |
krimirjinvatprithivi yadyadejati pravrishi tan nah sarpan mopa sripadyachchhivam tena no mrida ||
verses.en: What stinging (vṛ́çcika) harsh-biting serpent of thine lies in secret, winter-harmed, torpid (? bhṛmalá); whatever worm, O earth, becoming lively, stirs in the early rainy season—let that, crawling, not crawl upon us; be thou gracious to us with that which is propitious.

verses.sa:
ये ते पन्थानो बहवो जनायना रथस्य वर्त्मानसश्च यातवे ।
यैः संचरन्त्युभये भद्रपापास्तं पन्थानं जयेमानमित्रमतस्करं यच्छिवं तेन नो मृड ॥
verses.rom:
ye te panthano bahavo janayana rathasya vartmanasashcha yatave |
yaih samcharantyubhaye bhadrapapastam panthanam jayemanamitramataskaram yachchhivam tena no mrida ||
verses.en: What many roads thou hast, for people to go upon, a track (vártman) for the chariot, and for the going of the cart, by which (pl.) men of both kinds, excellent and evil, go about—that road, free from enemies, free from robbers, may we conquer; be thou gracious to us with that which is propitious.

verses.sa:
मल्वं बिभ्रती गुरुभृद्भद्रपापस्य निधनं तितिक्षुः ।
वराहेण पृथिवी संविदाना सूकराय वि जिहीते मृगाय ॥
verses.rom:
malvam bibhrati gurubhridbhadrapapasya nidhanam titikshuh |
varahena prithivi samvidana sukaraya vi jihite mrigaya ||
verses.en: Bearing the fool, bearer of what is heavy, enduring (titikṣú) the death (? nidhána) of the excellent and of the evil, the earth, in concord with the boar, opens itself to the wild (mṛgá) hog.

verses.sa:
ये त आरण्याः पशवो मृगा वने हिताः सिंहा व्याघ्राः पुरुषादश्चरन्ति ।
उलं वृकं पृथिवि दुछुनामित ऋक्षीकां रक्षो अप बाधयास्मत् ॥
verses.rom:
ye ta aranyah pashavo mriga vane hitah simha vyaghrah purushadashcharanti |
ulam vrikam prithivi duchhunamita rikshikam raksho apa badhayasmat ||
verses.en: What forest animals of thine, wild beasts set in the woods, lions, tigers, go about man-eating—the jackal (? ulá), the wolf, O earth, misfortune, the ṛkṣī́kā, the demon, do thou force (bādh) away from us here.

verses.sa:
ये गन्धर्वा अप्सरसो ये चारायाः किमीदिनः ।
पिशाचान्त्सर्वा रक्षांसि तान् अस्मद्भूमे यावय ॥
verses.rom:
ye gandharva apsaraso ye charayah kimidinah |
pishachantsarva rakshamsi tan asmadbhume yavaya ||
verses.en: What Gandharvas, Apsarases [there are], and what arā́yas, kimīdíns: the piçācás, all demons—them do thou keep away from us, O earth (bhū́mi).

verses.sa:
यां द्विपादः पक्षिणः संपतन्ति हंसाः सुपर्णाः शकुना वयांसि ।
यस्यां वातो मातरिश्वेयते रजांसि कृण्वंश्च्यावयंश्च वृक्षान् ।
वातस्य प्रवामुपवामनु वात्यर्चिः ॥
verses.rom:
yam dvipadah pakshinah sampatanti hamsah suparnah shakuna vayamsi |
yasyam vato matarishveyate rajamsi krinvamshchyavayamshcha vrikshan |
vatasya pravamupavamanu vatyarchih ||
verses.en: She to whom two-footed winged-ones fly together, swans, eagles, hawks, birds; on whom the wind, Mātariçvan, goes about, making clouds of dust (? rájas) and setting in motion the trees—flame (arcís) blows after the forth-blowing, the toward-blowing, of the wind.

verses.sa:
यस्यां कृष्णमरुणं च संहिते अहोरात्रे विहिते भूम्यामधि ।
वर्षेण भूमिः पृथिवी वृतावृता सा नो दधातु भद्रया प्रिये धामनिधामनि ॥
verses.rom:
yasyam krishnamarunam cha samhite ahoratre vihite bhumyamadhi |
varshena bhumih prithivi vritavrita sa no dadhatu bhadraya priye dhamanidhamani ||
verses.en: On whom the black and the ruddy, combined, [namely] day-and-night, [are] disposed upon the earth (bhū́mi); the broad (pṛthivī́) earth (bhū́mi), wrapped [and] covered with rain—let her kindly (bhadráyā) set us in each loved abode.

verses.sa:
द्यौश्च म इदं पृथिवी चान्तरिक्षं च मे व्यचः ।
अग्निः सूर्य आपो मेधां विश्वे देवाश्च सं ददुः ॥
verses.rom:
dyaushcha ma idam prithivi chantariksham cha me vyachah |
agnih surya apo medham vishve devashcha sam daduh ||
verses.en: Both heaven and earth and atmosphere [have given] me this expanse; fire, sun, waters, and all the gods have together given me wisdom (medhā́).

verses.sa:
अहमस्मि सहमान उत्तरो नाम भूम्याम् ।
अभीषाडस्मि विश्वाषाडाशामाशां विषासहिः ॥
verses.rom:
ahamasmi sahamana uttaro nama bhumyam |
abhishadasmi vishvashadashamasham vishasahih ||
verses.en: I am overpowering, superior by name on the earth (bhū́mi); I am subduing, all-overpowering, vanquishing in every region.

verses.sa:
अदो यद्देवि प्रथमाना पुरस्ताद्देवैरुक्ता व्यसर्पो महित्वम् ।
आ त्वा सुभूतमविशत्तदानीमकल्पयथाः प्रदिशश्चतस्रः ॥
verses.rom:
ado yaddevi prathamana purastaddevairukta vyasarpo mahitvam |
a tva subhutamavishattadanimakalpayathah pradishashchatasrah ||
verses.en: When yonder, O divine one, spreading thyself forward, told by the gods, thou didst expand (vi-sṛp) to greatness, then entered into thee well-being; thou didst make fit the four directions.

verses.sa:
ये ग्रामा यदरण्यं याः सभा अधि भूम्याम् ।
ये संग्रामाः समितयस्तेषु चारु वदेम ते ॥
verses.rom:
ye grama yadaranyam yah sabha adhi bhumyam |
ye samgramah samitayasteshu charu vadema te ||
verses.en: What villages, what forest, what assemblies, [are] upon the earth (bhū́mi), what hosts, gatherings—in them may we speak what is pleasant (cā́ru) to thee.

verses.sa:
अश्व इव रजो दुधुवे वि तान् जनान् य आक्षियन् पृथिवीं यादजायत ।
मन्द्राग्रेत्वरी भुवनस्य गोपा वनस्पतीनां गृभिरोषधीनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
ashva iva rajo dudhuve vi tan janan ya akshiyan prithivim yadajayata |
mandragretvari bhuvanasya gopa vanaspatinam gribhiroshadhinam ||
verses.en: As a horse the dust, she has shaken apart those people who dwelt upon the earth since (yā́t) she was born—pleasing, going at the head, keeper of creation (bhúvana), container of forest trees, of herbs.

verses.sa:
यद्वदामि मधुमत्तद्वदामि यदीक्षे तद्वनन्ति मा ।
त्विषीमान् अस्मि जूतिमान् अवान्यान् हन्मि दोधतः ॥
verses.rom:
yadvadami madhumattadvadami yadikshe tadvananti ma |
tvishiman asmi jutiman avanyan hanmi dodhatah ||
verses.en: What I speak, rich in honey I speak it; what I view, that they win (? van) me; brilliant am I, possessed of swiftness; I smite down others that are violent (? dódhat).

verses.sa:
शन्तिवा सुरभिः स्योना कीलालोध्नी पयस्वती ।
भूमिरधि ब्रवीतु मे पृथिवी पयसा सह ॥
verses.rom:
shantiva surabhih syona kilalodhni payasvati |
bhumiradhi bravitu me prithivi payasa saha ||
verses.en: Tranquil, fragrant, pleasant, with sweet drink in her udder, rich in milk, let earth (bhū́mi) bless me, earth together with milk.

verses.sa:
यामन्वैच्छद्धविषा विश्वकर्मान्तरर्णवे रजसि प्रविष्टाम् ।
भुजिष्यं पात्रं निहितं गुहा यदाविर्भोगे अभवन् मातृमद्भ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
yamanvaichchhaddhavisha vishvakarmantararnave rajasi pravishtam |
bhujishyam patram nihitam guha yadavirbhoge abhavan matrimadbhyah ||
verses.en: Whom Viçvakarman sought after with oblation within the ocean, when she was entered into the mist (? rájas); an enjoyable vessel that was deposited in secret became manifest in enjoyment (bhóga) for them that have mothers.

verses.sa:
त्वमस्यावपनी जनानामदितिः कामदुघा पप्रथाना ।
यत्त ऊनं तत्त आ पूरयाति प्रजापतिः प्रथमजा ऋतस्य ॥
verses.rom:
tvamasyavapani jananamaditih kamadugha paprathana |
yatta unam tatta a purayati prajapatih prathamaja ritasya ||
verses.en: Thou art the scatterer (? āvápana) of people, [art] a wish-fulfilling (kāmadúgha) Aditi, spreading out; what of thee is deficient, may Prajāpati, first-born of righteousness, fill that up for thee.

verses.sa:
उपस्थास्ते अनमीवा अयक्ष्मा अस्मभ्यं सन्तु पृथिवि प्रसूताः ।
दीर्घं न आयुः प्रतिबुध्यमाना वयं तुभ्यं बलिहृतः स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
upasthaste anamiva ayakshma asmabhyam santu prithivi prasutah |
dirgham na ayuh pratibudhyamana vayam tubhyam balihritah syama ||
verses.en: Let slanders upon thee, free from disease, free from yákṣma, be produced (prásūta) for us, O earth; awakening to meet our long lifetime, may we be tribute-bearers to thee.

verses.sa:
भूमे मातर्नि धेहि मा भद्रया सुप्रतिष्ठितम् ।
संविदाना दिवा कवे श्रियां मा धेहि भूत्याम् ॥
verses.rom:
bhume matarni dhehi ma bhadraya supratishthitam |
samvidana diva kave shriyam ma dhehi bhutyam ||
verses.en: O mother earth (bhū́mi), do thou kindly set me down well established; in concord with the heaven, O sage (kávi), do thou set me in fortune, in prosperity (bhū́ti).

verses.sa:
नडमा रोह न ते अत्र लोक इदं सीसं भागधेयं त एहि ।
यो गोषु यक्ष्मः पुरुषेषु यक्ष्मस्तेन त्वं साकमधराङ्परेहि ॥
verses.rom:
nadama roha na te atra loka idam sisam bhagadheyam ta ehi |
yo goshu yakshmah purusheshu yakshmastena tvam sakamadharanparehi ||
verses.en: Ascend the reeds (naḍá); no place for thee is here; this lead is thy portion; come! what yákṣma is in kine, [what] yákṣma in men, in company with that do thou go forth downward.

verses.sa:
अघशंसदुःशंसाभ्यां करेणानुकरेण च ।
यक्ष्मं च सर्वं तेनेतो मृत्युं च निरजामसि ॥
verses.rom:
aghashamsaduhshamsabhyam karenanukarena cha |
yakshmam cha sarvam teneto mrityum cha nirajamasi ||
verses.en: By evil-plotter and ill-plotter, by actor and helper, both all yákṣma and death do we thereby drive out from here.

verses.sa:
निरितो मृत्युं निर्ऋतिं निररातिमजामसि ।
यो नो द्वेष्टि तमद्ध्यग्ने अक्रव्याद्यमु द्विष्मस्तमु ते प्र सुवामसि ॥
verses.rom:
nirito mrityum nirritim niraratimajamasi |
yo no dveshti tamaddhyagne akravyadyamu dvishmastamu te pra suvamasi ||
verses.en: Out from here do we drive death, perdition, out the niggard; whoso hates us, him, O non-flesh-eating Agni, do thou eat; whomso we hate, him do we impel to thee.

verses.sa:
यद्यग्निः क्रव्याद्यदि वा व्याघ्र इमं गोष्ठं प्रविवेशान्योकाः ।
तं माषाज्यं कृत्वा प्र हिणोमि दूरं स गच्छत्वप्सुषदोऽप्यग्नीन् ॥
verses.rom:
yadyagnih kravyadyadi va vyaghra imam goshtham praviveshanyokah |
tam mashajyam kritva pra hinomi duram sa gachchhatvapsushado'pyagnin ||
verses.en: If the flesh-eating Agni, or if the tiger-like, hath entered this stall (goṣṭhá), being not at home (?), him, having made him to have beans for sacrificial butter, I send far forth; let him go unto the Agnis that have seat in the waters.

verses.sa:
यत्त्वा क्रुद्धाः प्रचक्रुर्मन्युना पुरुषे मृते ।
सुकल्पमग्ने तत्त्वया पुनस्त्वोद्दीपयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
yattva kruddhah prachakrurmanyuna purushe mrite |
sukalpamagne tattvaya punastvoddipayamasi ||
verses.en: If angry men put thee forth (pra-kṛ), with fury, a man having died, that, O Agni, is easy to be arranged by thee; we make thee flame up again.

verses.sa:
पुनस्त्वादित्या रुद्रा वसवः पुनर्ब्रह्मा वसुनीतिरग्ने ।
पुनस्त्वा ब्रह्मणस्पतिराधाद्दीर्घायुत्वाय शतशारदाय ॥
verses.rom:
punastvaditya rudra vasavah punarbrahma vasunitiragne |
punastva brahmanaspatiradhaddirghayutvaya shatasharadaya ||
verses.en: The Ādityas, the Rudras, the Vasus [have set] thee again; again, O Agni, the priest (brahmán), conductor of good; Brahmaṇaspati hath set thee again, in order to length of life-time to a hundred autumns.

verses.sa:
यो अग्निः क्रव्यात्प्रविवेश नो गृहमिमं पश्यन्न् इतरं जातवेदसम् ।
तं हरामि पितृयज्ञाय दूरं स घर्ममिन्धां परमे सधस्थे ॥
verses.rom:
yo agnih kravyatpravivesha no grihamimam pashyann itaram jatavedasam |
tam harami pitriyajnaya duram sa gharmamindham parame sadhasthe ||
verses.en: If the flesh-eating Agni hath entered our house, seeing this other Jātavedas, him I take afar for the Fathers' sacrifice; let him kindle the hot drink (gharmá) in the highest station.

verses.sa:
क्रव्यादमग्निं प्र हिणोमि दूरं यमराज्ञो गच्छतु रिप्रवाहः ।
इहायमितरो जातवेदा देवो देवेभ्यो हव्यं वहतु प्रजानन् ॥
verses.rom:
kravyadamagnim pra hinomi duram yamarajno gachchhatu ripravahah |
ihayamitaro jataveda devo devebhyo havyam vahatu prajanan ||
verses.en: I send far forth the flesh-eating Agni; let him go, carrying evil (riprá-), to Yama's subjects; here let this other Jātavedas carry the oblation, a god to the gods, foreknowing.

verses.sa:
क्रव्यादमग्निमिषितो हरामि जनान् दृंहन्तं वज्रेण मृत्युम् ।
नि तं शास्मि गार्हपत्येन विद्वान् पितॄणां लोकेऽपि भागो अस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
kravyadamagnimishito harami janan drimhantam vajrena mrityum |
ni tam shasmi garhapatyena vidvan pitrinam loke'pi bhago astu ||
verses.en: I, being sent, take the flesh-eating Agni, a death, making people fixed with the thunderbolt; I, knowing, separate (? ni-çās) him from the householder's fire; also in the world of the Fathers be he [their] portion.

verses.sa:
क्रव्यादमग्निं शशमानमुक्थ्यं प्र हिणोमि पथिभिः पितृयाणैः ।
मा देवयानैः पुनरा गा अत्रैवैधि पितृषु जागृहि त्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
kravyadamagnim shashamanamukthyam pra hinomi pathibhih pitriyanaih |
ma devayanaih punara ga atraivaidhi pitrishu jagrihi tvam ||
verses.en: The flesh-eating Agni, active, praiseworthy, I send forth by the roads that the Fathers go; come thou not back by those that the gods go; be thou just there (átra); watch thou over the Fathers.

verses.sa:
समिन्धते संकसुकं स्वस्तये शुद्धा भवन्तः शुचयः पावकाः ।
जहाति रिप्रमत्येन एति समिद्धो अग्निः सुपुना पुनाति ॥
verses.rom:
samindhate samkasukam svastaye shuddha bhavantah shuchayah pavakah |
jahati ripramatyena eti samiddho agnih supuna punati ||
verses.en: They kindle the devouring one (sáṁkasuka) in order to well-being, becoming cleansed, bright, purifying; he abandons evil (riprá), passes over sin; Agni, kindled, purifies with a good purifier.

verses.sa:
देवो अग्निः संकसुको दिवस्पृष्ठान्यारुहत्।
मुच्यमानो निरेणसोऽमोगस्मामशस्त्याः ॥
verses.rom:
devo agnih samkasuko divasprishthanyaruhat|
muchyamano nirenaso'mogasmamashastyah ||
verses.en: God Agni the devouring hath ascended the backs of the sky; being released out of sin, he hath released us from imprecation.

verses.sa:
अस्मिन् वयं संकसुके अग्नौ रिप्राणि मृज्महे ।
अभूम यज्ञियाः शुद्धाः प्र ण आयूंषि तारिषत् ॥
verses.rom:
asmin vayam samkasuke agnau riprani mrijmahe |
abhuma yajniyah shuddhah pra na ayumshi tarishat ||
verses.en: On this devouring Agni do we wipe off evils; we have become fit for sacrifice, cleansed; may he prolong our life-times.

verses.sa:
संकसुको विकसुको निर्ऋथो यश्च निस्वरः ।
ते ते यक्ष्मं सवेदसो दूराद्दूरमनीनशन् ॥
verses.rom:
samkasuko vikasuko nirritho yashcha nisvarah |
te te yakshmam savedaso duradduramaninashan ||
verses.en: The crushing sáṁkasuka, the bursting (víkasuka), the destroying (nirṛthá) and the noiseless (? nisvará)—they, of like possessions (? sávedas), have made from far thy yákṣma to disappear afar.

verses.sa:
यो नो अश्वेषु वीरेषु यो नो गोष्वजाविषु ।
क्रव्यादं निर्णुदामसि यो अग्निर्जनयोपनः ॥
verses.rom:
yo no ashveshu vireshu yo no goshvajavishu |
kravyadam nirnudamasi yo agnirjanayopanah ||
verses.en: The flesh-eating one that is in our horses, heroes, that is in our kine, goats-and-sheep, do we thrust out—the fire that obstructs the people.

verses.sa:
अन्येभ्यस्त्वा पुरुषेभ्यो गोभ्यो अश्वेभ्यस्त्वा ।
निः क्रव्यादं नुदामसि यो अग्निर्जीवितयोपनः ॥
verses.rom:
anyebhyastva purushebhyo gobhyo ashvebhyastva |
nih kravyadam nudamasi yo agnirjivitayopanah ||
verses.en: Thee from inexhaustible (? ánya) men, kine, horses, thee the flesh-eating one do we thrust out—the fire that obstructs life.

verses.sa:
यस्मिन् देवा अमृजत यस्मिन् मनुष्या उत ।
तस्मिन् घृतस्तावो मृष्ट्वा त्वमग्ने दिवं रुह ॥
verses.rom:
yasmin deva amrijata yasmin manushya uta |
tasmin ghritastavo mrishtva tvamagne divam ruha ||
verses.en: On what the gods wiped off, on what human beings (manuṣyà) also—on that having wiped off the drops of ghee (?), O Agni, do thou mount the sky.

verses.sa:
समिद्धो अग्न आहुत स नो माभ्यपक्रमीः ।
अत्रैव दीदिहि द्यवि ज्योक्च सूर्यं दृशे ॥
verses.rom:
samiddho agna ahuta sa no mabhyapakramih |
atraiva didihi dyavi jyokcha suryam drishe ||
verses.en: Being kindled, O Agni, thou to whom oblations are made, go (kram) thou not away against us; shine just here by day, and that [we] long see the sun.

verses.sa:
सीसे मृड्ढ्वं नडे मृड्ढ्वमग्नौ संकसुके च यत्।
अथो अव्यां रामायां शीर्षक्तिमुपबर्हणे ॥
verses.rom:
sise mriddhvam nade mriddhvamagnau samkasuke cha yat|
atho avyam ramayam shirshaktimupabarhane ||
verses.en: Wipe ye off on the lead; wipe ye off on the reeds; and what on the consuming fire; likewise on the dark (rāmá) ewe; headache on the pillow.

verses.sa:
सीसे मलं सादयित्वा शीर्षक्तिमुपबर्हणे ।
अव्यामसिक्न्यां मृष्ट्वा शुद्धा भवत यज्ञियाः ॥
verses.rom:
sise malam sadayitva shirshaktimupabarhane |
avyamasiknyam mrishtva shuddha bhavata yajniyah ||
verses.en: Having settled what is foul upon the lead [and] headache upon the pillow, having wiped off on the black ewe, be ye cleansed, fit for sacrifice.

verses.sa:
परं मृत्यो अनु परेहि पन्थां यस्त एष इतरो देवयानात्।
चक्षुष्मते शृण्वते ते ब्रवीमीहेमे वीरा बहवो भवन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
param mrityo anu parehi pantham yasta esha itaro devayanat|
chakshushmate shrinvate te bravimiheme vira bahavo bhavantu ||
verses.en: Go away, O death, along a distant road which is thine here, other than that the gods go upon; I speak to thee having sight, hearing; let these many heroes be here.

verses.sa:
इमे जीवा वि मृतैराववृत्रन्न् अभूद्भद्रा देवहूतिर्नो अद्य ।
प्राञ्चो अगाम नृतये हसाय सुवीरासो विदथमा वदेम ॥
verses.rom:
ime jiva vi mritairavavritrann abhudbhadra devahutirno adya |
prancho agama nritaye hasaya suviraso vidathama vadema ||
verses.en: These living ones have turned away from the dead; our invocation of the gods hath been auspicious (bhadrá) today; we have gone forward unto dancing, unto laughter; may we, rich in heroes, address counsel.

verses.sa:
इमं जीवेभ्यः परिधिं दधामि मैषां नु गादपरो अर्थमेतम् ।
शतं जीवन्तः शरदः पुरूचीस्तिरो मृत्युं दधतां पर्वतेन ॥
verses.rom:
imam jivebhyah paridhim dadhami maisham nu gadaparo arthametam |
shatam jivantah sharadah puruchistiro mrityum dadhatam parvatena ||
verses.en: I set this enclosure for the living; let not another of them now go to that goal; living a hundred numerous autumns, let them set an obstacle to death with a mountain.

verses.sa:
आ रोहतायुर्जरसं वृणाना अनुपूर्वं यतमाना यति स्थ ।
तान् वस्त्वष्टा सुजनिमा सजोषाः सर्वमायुर्नयतु जीवनाय ॥
verses.rom:
a rohatayurjarasam vrinana anupurvam yatamana yati stha |
tan vastvashta sujanima sajoshah sarvamayurnayatu jivanaya ||
verses.en: Mount, choosing old age for life-time, pressing on, one after another, as many as ye be; you here let Tvashṭar, him of good births, in accord [with you], lead on to living your whole life-time.

verses.sa:
यथाहान्यनुपूर्वं भवन्ति यथ र्तव ऋतुभिर्यन्ति साकम् ।
यथा न पूर्वमपरो जहात्येवा धातरायूंषि कल्पयैषाम् ॥
verses.rom:
yathahanyanupurvam bhavanti yatha rtava ritubhiryanti sakam |
yatha na purvamaparo jahatyeva dhatarayumshi kalpayaisham ||
verses.en: As days take place (bhū) one after another, as seasons go along with seasons, as an after one does not desert (hā) a preceding—so, O creator (dhā́tṛ), arrange their life-times.

verses.sa:
अश्मन्वती रीयते सं रभध्वं वीरयध्वं प्र तरता सखायः ।
अत्रा जहीत ये असन् दुरेवा अनमीवान् उत्तरेमाभि वाजान् ॥
verses.rom:
ashmanvati riyate sam rabhadhvam virayadhvam pra tarata sakhayah |
atra jahita ye asan dureva anamivan uttaremabhi vajan ||
verses.en: The stony one flows (rī); take ye hold together; play the hero, pass over, O friends; quit here them that are of evil courses; may we pass up unto powers (? vā́ja) that are free from disease.

verses.sa:
उत्तिष्ठता प्र तरता सखायोऽश्मन्वती नदी स्यन्दत इयम् ।
अत्रा जहीत ये असन्न् अशिवाः शिवान्त्स्योनान् उत्तरेमाभि वाजान् ॥
verses.rom:
uttishthata pra tarata sakhayo'shmanvati nadi syandata iyam |
atra jahita ye asann ashivah shivantsyonan uttaremabhi vajan ||
verses.en: Stand up, pass over, O friends; the stony river here runs (syand); quit ye here them that are unpropitious; may we pass up unto propitious pleasant powers.

verses.sa:
वैश्वदेवीं वर्चसा आ रभध्वं शुद्धा भवन्तः शुचयः पावकाः ।
अतिक्रामन्तो दुरिता पदानि शतं हिमाः सर्ववीरा मदेम ॥
verses.rom:
vaishvadevim varchasa a rabhadhvam shuddha bhavantah shuchayah pavakah |
atikramanto durita padani shatam himah sarvavira madema ||
verses.en: Take ye hold on that of all the gods in order to splendor, becoming cleansed, clear, purifying; stepping over difficult tracks, may we revel a hundred winters with all our heroes.

verses.sa:
उदीचीनैः पथिभिर्वायुमद्भिरतिक्रामन्तोऽवरान् परेभिः ।
त्रिः सप्त कृत्व ऋषयः परेता मृत्युं प्रत्यौहन् पदयोपनेन ॥
verses.rom:
udichinaih pathibhirvayumadbhiratikramanto'varan parebhih |
trih sapta kritva rishayah pareta mrityum pratyauhan padayopanena ||
verses.en: By upward roads, full of wind, by distant (pára) ones, stepping over those that are lower (ávara), thrice seven times did the departed (páreta) seers bear back death with the track-obstructor.

verses.sa:
मृत्योः पदं योपयन्त एत द्राघीय आयुः प्रतरं दधानाः ।
आसीना मृत्युं नुदता सधस्थेऽथ जीवासो विदथमा वदेम ॥
verses.rom:
mrityoh padam yopayanta eta draghiya ayuh prataram dadhanah |
asina mrityum nudata sadhasthe'tha jivaso vidathama vadema ||
verses.en: Come ye, obstructing the track of death, assuming further on a longer life-time; sitting in your station, thrust ye [away] death; then may we, living, speak to the council.

verses.sa:
इमा नारीरविधवाः सुपत्नीराञ्जनेन सर्पिषा सं स्पृशन्ताम् ।
अनश्रवो अनमीवाः सुरत्ना आ रोहन्तु जनयो योनिमग्रे ॥
verses.rom:
ima nariravidhavah supatniranjanena sarpisha sam sprishantam |
anashravo anamivah suratna a rohantu janayo yonimagre ||
verses.en: Let these women, not widows, well-spoused, touch themselves with ointment, with butter; tearless, without disease, with good treasures (-rátna), let the wives ascend first to the place of union (yóni).

verses.sa:
व्याकरोमि हविषाहमेतौ तौ ब्रह्मणा व्यहं कल्पयामि ।
स्वधां पितृभ्यो अजरां कृणोमि दीर्घेणायुषा समिमान्त्सृजामि ॥
verses.rom:
vyakaromi havishahametau tau brahmana vyaham kalpayami |
svadham pitribhyo ajaram krinomi dirghenayusha samimantsrijami ||
verses.en: I separate (vy-ā-kṛ) these two by oblation; I shape them apart with a spell (bráhman); I make for the Fathers unwasting svadhā́; I unite these with a long life-time.

verses.sa:
यो नो अग्निः पितरो हृत्स्वन्तराविवेशामृतो मर्त्येषु ।
मय्यहं तं परि गृह्णामि देवं मा सो अस्मान् द्विक्षत मा वयं तम् ॥
verses.rom:
yo no agnih pitaro hritsvantaraviveshamrito martyeshu |
mayyaham tam pari grihnami devam ma so asman dvikshata ma vayam tam ||
verses.en: What Agni, O Fathers, hath entered into our hearts, an immortal into mortals, that god do I enclose in me; let him not hate us, nor let us [hate] him.

verses.sa:
अपावृत्य गार्हपत्यात्क्रव्यादा प्रेत दक्षिणा ।
प्रियं पितृभ्य आत्मने ब्रह्मभ्यः कृणुता प्रियम् ॥
verses.rom:
apavritya garhapatyatkravyada preta dakshina |
priyam pitribhya atmane brahmabhyah krinuta priyam ||
verses.en: Having turned away from the householder's fire, go ye forth to the right with the flesh-eating one; do ye what is dear to the Fathers, to self, what is dear to the priests (brahmán).

verses.sa:
द्विभागधनमादाय प्र क्षिणात्यवर्त्या ।
अग्निः पुत्रस्य ज्येष्ठस्य यः क्रव्यादनिराहितः ॥
verses.rom:
dvibhagadhanamadaya pra kshinatyavartya |
agnih putrasya jyeshthasya yah kravyadanirahitah ||
verses.en: The flesh-eating Agni that is unremoved (á-nir-ā-hita), taking to himself the double-portioned riches of the oldest son, destroys [him] with ruin.

verses.sa:
यत्कृषते यद्वनुते यच्च वस्नेन विन्दते ।
सर्वं मर्त्यस्य तन् नास्ति क्रव्याच्चेदनिराहितः ॥
verses.rom:
yatkrishate yadvanute yachcha vasnena vindate |
sarvam martyasya tan nasti kravyachchedanirahitah ||
verses.en: What one plows, what one wins (van), and what one gains (vid) by pay (vasná)—all that is not a mortal's, if the flesh-eating one be unremoved.

verses.sa:
अयज्ञियो हतवर्चा भवति नैनेन हविरत्तवे ।
छिनत्ति कृष्या गोर्धनाद्यं क्रव्यादनुवर्तते ॥
verses.rom:
ayajniyo hatavarcha bhavati nainena havirattave |
chhinatti krishya gordhanadyam kravyadanuvartate ||
verses.en: He becomes unfit for sacrifice, of smitten splendor; not by him is the oblation to be eaten; [him] the flesh-eating one cuts off from plowing, kine, riches, whom it pursues.

verses.sa:
मुहुर्गृध्यैः प्र वदत्यार्तिं मर्त्यो नीत्य ।
क्रव्याद्यान् अग्निरन्तिकादनुविद्वान् वितावति ॥
verses.rom:
muhurgridhyaih pra vadatyartim martyo nitya |
kravyadyan agnirantikadanuvidvan vitavati ||
verses.en: A mortal, going down to mishap, speaks forth repeatedly with greedy ones (? gṛ́dhya); whom (pl.) the flesh-eating Agni, from near by, after-knowing, follows (? vi-tāv).

verses.sa:
ग्राह्या गृहाः सं सृज्यन्ते स्त्रिया यन् म्रियते पतिः ।
ब्रह्मैव विद्वान् एष्यो यः क्रव्यादं निरादधत् ॥
verses.rom:
grahya grihah sam srijyante striya yan mriyate patih |
brahmaiva vidvan eshyo yah kravyadam niradadhat ||
verses.en: The houses are united with seizure (grā́hi) when a woman's husband dies; a knowing priest (brahmán) is to be sought, who shall remove the flesh-eating one.

verses.sa:
यद्रिप्रं शमलं चकृम यच्च दुष्कृतम् ।
आपो मा तस्माच्छुम्भन्त्वग्नेः संकसुकाच्च यत् ॥
verses.rom:
yadripram shamalam chakrima yachcha dushkritam |
apo ma tasmachchhumbhantvagneh samkasukachcha yat ||
verses.en: What evil (riprá), pollution we have committed, and what ill-doing, from that let the waters cleanse me, and from the crushing Agni what.

verses.sa:
ता अधरादुदीचीराववृत्रन् प्रजानैतीः पथिभिर्देवयानैः ।
पर्वतस्य वृषभस्याधि पृष्ठे नवाश्चरन्ति सरितः पुराणीः ॥
verses.rom:
ta adharadudichiravavritran prajanaitih pathibhirdevayanaih |
parvatasya vrishabhasyadhi prishthe navashcharanti saritah puranih ||
verses.en: These fore-knowing ones (f.) have turned hither upward from below by roads that the gods go upon; upon the back of the virile (vṛṣabhá) mountain the ancient streams (sarít) go about new.

verses.sa: अग्ने अक्रव्यान् निः क्रव्यादं नुदा देवयजनं वह ॥
verses.rom: agne akravyan nih kravyadam nuda devayajanam vaha ||
verses.en: O non-flesh-eating Agni, push out the flesh-eating one; bring the god-sacrificing one.

verses.sa:
इमं क्रव्यादा विवेशायं क्रव्यादमन्वगात्।
व्याघ्रौ कृत्वा नानानं तं हरामि शिवापरम् ॥
verses.rom:
imam kravyada viveshayam kravyadamanvagat|
vyaghrau kritva nananam tam harami shivaparam ||
verses.en: The flesh-eating one entered into this man; he has gone after the flesh-eating one; having made two tigers severally, I take him, who is other than propitious.

verses.sa: अन्तर्धिर्देवानां परिधिर्मनुष्याणामग्निर्गार्हपत्य उभयान् अन्तरा श्रितः ॥
verses.rom: antardhirdevanam paridhirmanushyanamagnirgarhapatya ubhayan antara shritah ||
verses.en: Concealment of the gods, defense (paridhí) of men (manuṣyà), the householder's fire is set (çritá) between both classes.

verses.sa:
जीवानामायुः प्र तिर त्वमग्ने पितॄणां लोकमपि गच्छन्तु ये मृताः ।
सुगार्हपत्यो वितपन्न् अरातिमुषामुषां श्रेयसीं धेह्यस्मै ॥
verses.rom:
jivanamayuh pra tira tvamagne pitrinam lokamapi gachchhantu ye mritah |
sugarhapatyo vitapann aratimushamusham shreyasim dhehyasmai ||
verses.en: Lengthen thou out, O Agni, the life-time of the living; let them who are dead go unto the world of the Fathers; do thou, a good householder's fire, burning away the niggard, assign to this man an ever better dawn.

verses.sa: सर्वान् अग्ने सहमानः सपत्नान् ऐषामूर्जं रयिमस्मासु धेहि ॥
verses.rom: sarvan agne sahamanah sapatnan aishamurjam rayimasmasu dhehi ||
verses.en: Overcoming, O Agni, all [our] rivals, do thou assign to us their refreshment [and] wealth.

verses.sa:
इममिन्द्रं वह्निं पप्रिमन्वारभध्वं स वो निर्वक्षद्दुरितादवद्यात्।
तेनाप हत शरुमापतन्तं तेन रुद्रस्य परि पातास्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
imamindram vahnim paprimanvarabhadhvam sa vo nirvakshadduritadavadyat|
tenapa hata sharumapatantam tena rudrasya pari patastam ||
verses.en: Take ye hold after this saving (pápri) carrier (váhni) Indra; he shall carry you out of difficulty [and] reproach; by him smite away the on-flying shaft; by him ward off (pari-pā) Rudra's hurled [missile].

verses.sa:
अनड्वाहं प्लवमन्वारभध्वं स वो निर्वक्षद्दुरितादवद्यात्।
आ रोहत सवितुर्नावमेतां षड्भिरुर्वीभिरमतिं तरेम ॥
verses.rom:
anadvaham plavamanvarabhadhvam sa vo nirvakshadduritadavadyat|
a rohata saviturnavametam shadbhirurvibhiramatim tarema ||
verses.en: Lay ye hold after the draft-ox [as] float (plavá); he shall carry you out of difficulty [and] reproach; mount this boat of Savitar; may we cross over misery by the six wide [directions].

verses.sa:
अहोरात्रे अन्वेषि बिभ्रत्क्षेम्यस्तिष्ठन् प्रतरणः सुवीरः ।
अनातुरान्त्सुमनसस्तल्प बिभ्रज्ज्योगेव नः पुरुषगन्धिरेधि ॥
verses.rom:
ahoratre anveshi bibhratkshemyastishthan prataranah suvirah |
anaturantsumanasastalpa bibhrajjyogeva nah purushagandhiredhi ||
verses.en: Day-and-night thou goest after, bearing, standing comfortable (kṣemyá), prolonging [life], having good heroes; bearing, O couch, healthful (ánātura), well-minded ones (m.), do thou long be for us smelling of men (púrusagandhi).

verses.sa:
ते देवेभ्य आ वृश्चन्ते पापं जीवन्ति सर्वदा ।
क्रव्याद्यान् अग्निरन्तिकादश्व इवानुवपते नडम् ॥
verses.rom:
te devebhya a vrishchante papam jivanti sarvada |
kravyadyan agnirantikadashva ivanuvapate nadam ||
verses.en: They fall under the wrath of the gods, they live always evilly, after whom the flesh-eating fire, from near by, like a horse, scatters reeds.

verses.sa:
येऽश्रद्धा धनकाम्या क्रव्यादा समासते ।
ते वा अन्येषां कुम्भीं पर्यादधति सर्वदा ॥
verses.rom:
ye'shraddha dhanakamya kravyada samasate |
te va anyesham kumbhim paryadadhati sarvada ||
verses.en: Whoever, without faith, from desire of riches then sit together with the flesh-eating one, they verily feed the fire (ā-dhā) about the pot (kumbhī́) of others always.

verses.sa:
प्रेव पिपतिषति मनसा मुहुरा वर्तते पुनः ।
क्रव्याद्यान् अग्निरन्तिकादनुविद्वान् वितावति ॥
verses.rom:
preva pipatishati manasa muhura vartate punah |
kravyadyan agnirantikadanuvidvan vitavati ||
verses.en: He desires, as it were, to fly forth with his mind; repeatedly he returns again—they whom the flesh-eating Agni, from near by, after-knowing follows.

verses.sa:
अविः कृष्णा भागधेयं पशूनां सीसं क्रव्यादपि चन्द्रं त आहुः ।
माषाः पिष्टा भागधेयं ते हव्यमरण्यान्या गह्वरं सचस्व ॥
verses.rom:
avih krishna bhagadheyam pashunam sisam kravyadapi chandram ta ahuh |
mashah pishta bhagadheyam te havyamaranyanya gahvaram sachasva ||
verses.en: A black ewe [is] of cattle [thy] portion; lead, too, they call thy gold (? candrá), O flesh-eating one; ground beans are thy portion [as] oblation; seek (sac) thou the thicket of the forest-spirit (araṇyānī́).

verses.sa:
इषीकां जरतीमिष्ट्वा तिल्पिञ्जं दण्डनं नडम् ।
तमिन्द्र इध्मं कृत्वा यमस्याग्निं निरादधौ ॥
verses.rom:
ishikam jaratimishtva tilpinjam dandanam nadam |
tamindra idhmam kritva yamasyagnim niradadhau ||
verses.en: Having made offering of withered (? járat) cane (iṣī́kā), of tilpíñja, of dáṇḍana, of reeds; having made fuel of this, Indra removed Yama's fire.

verses.sa:
प्रत्यञ्चमर्कं प्रत्यर्पयित्वा प्रविद्वान् पन्थां वि ह्याविवेश ।
परामीषामसून् दिदेश दीर्घेणायुषा समिमान्त्सृजामि ॥
verses.rom:
pratyanchamarkam pratyarpayitva pravidvan pantham vi hyavivesha |
paramishamasun didesha dirghenayusha samimantsrijami ||
verses.en: Having sent in opposition an opposing (pratyáñc) song (arká), I, foreknowing, have entered abroad on the road; I have directed away the lifebreaths of them yonder; these here I unite with long life-time.

verses.sa:
पुमान् पुंसोऽधि तिष्ठ चर्मेहि तत्र ह्वयस्व यतमा प्रिया ते ।
यावन्तावग्रे प्रथमं समेयथुस्तद्वां वयो यमराज्ये समानम् ॥
verses.rom:
puman pumso'dhi tishtha charmehi tatra hvayasva yatama priya te |
yavantavagre prathamam sameyathustadvam vayo yamarajye samanam ||
verses.en: Stand, a man (púmāṅs), upon men; go to the hide; call thither her who is dear to thee; of what age (? yā́vant) ye two first came together in the beginning, let that be your same age in Yama's realm.

verses.sa:
तावद्वां चक्षुस्तति वीर्याणि तावत्तेजस्ततिधा वाजिनानि ।
अग्निः शरीरं सचते यदैधोऽधा पक्वान् मिथुना सं भवाथः ॥
verses.rom:
tavadvam chakshustati viryani tavattejastatidha vajinani |
agnih shariram sachate yadaidho'dha pakvan mithuna sam bhavathah ||
verses.en: So much [be] your sight, so many your powers (vīryà), so great your brilliancy (téjas), so many-fold your energies (vā́jina); Agni fastens on (sac) the body when [it is his] fuel (?); then, O paired ones (mithuná), shall ye come into being from what is cooked (pakvá).

verses.sa:
समस्मिंल्लोके समु देवयाने सं स्मा समेतं यमराज्येषु ।
पूतौ पवित्रैरुप तद्ध्वयेथां यद्यद्रेतो अधि वां संबभूव ॥
verses.rom:
samasmimlloke samu devayane sam sma sametam yamarajyeshu |
putau pavitrairupa taddhvayetham yadyadreto adhi vam sambabhuva ||
verses.en: Together in this world, together on the [road] the gods travel, together also unite ye (du.) in the realms of Yama; purified by purifiers, call ye to yourselves whatever seed (rétas) came into being from you.

verses.sa:
आपस्पुत्रासो अभि सं विशध्वमिमं जीवं जीवधन्याः समेत्य ।
तासां भजध्वममृतं यमाहुरोदनं पचति वां जनित्री ॥
verses.rom:
apasputraso abhi sam vishadhvamimam jivam jivadhanyah sametya |
tasam bhajadhvamamritam yamahurodanam pachati vam janitri ||
verses.en: Enter together, ye sons, into the waters, coming together, ye rich in life, unto this living one (m.); of them (f.) share ye the one which (m.) they call immortal, the rice-dish which your (du.) generatrix cooks.

verses.sa:
यं वां पिता पचति यं च माता रिप्रान् निर्मुक्त्यै शमलाच्च वाचः ।
स ओदनः शतधारः स्वर्ग उभे व्याप नभसी महित्वा ॥
verses.rom:
yam vam pita pachati yam cha mata ripran nirmuktyai shamalachcha vachah |
sa odanah shatadharah svarga ubhe vyapa nabhasi mahitva ||
verses.en: What one your (du.) father cooks, and what one [your] mother, in order to release from evil (riprá) and from pollution of speech—that hundred-streamed, heaven-going rice-dish hath permeated (vi-āp) with greatness both firmaments (nábhas).

verses.sa:
उभे नभसी उभयांश्च लोकान् ये यज्वनामभिजिताः स्वर्गाः ।
तेषां ज्योतिष्मान् मधुमान् यो अग्रे तस्मिन् पुत्रैर्जरसि सं श्रयेथाम् ॥
verses.rom:
ubhe nabhasi ubhayamshcha lokan ye yajvanamabhijitah svargah |
tesham jyotishman madhuman yo agre tasmin putrairjarasi sam shrayetham ||
verses.en: Both firmaments, and worlds of both kinds, what heaven-going ones are conquered of the sacrificers—which one of them is chiefly (? ágre) full of light, full of honey, in that combine ye (du.) with your sons in old age.

verses.sa:
प्राचींप्राचीं प्रदिशमा रभेथामेतं लोकं श्रद्दधानाः सचन्ते ।
यद्वां पक्वं परिविष्टमग्नौ तस्य गुप्तये दंपती सं श्रयेथाम् ॥
verses.rom:
prachimprachim pradishama rabhethametam lokam shraddadhanah sachante |
yadvam pakvam parivishtamagnau tasya guptaye dampati sam shrayetham ||
verses.en: Take ye (du.) hold upon each forward direction; to this world they that have faith attach themselves (sac); what of you that is cooked is served up in the fire, combine ye, O husband-and-wife, in order to its guarding.

verses.sa:
दक्षिणां दिशमभि नक्षमाणौ पर्यावर्तेथामभि पात्रमेतत्।
तस्मिन् वां यमः पितृभिः संविदानः पक्वाय शर्म बहुलं नि यच्छात् ॥
verses.rom:
dakshinam dishamabhi nakshamanau paryavartethamabhi patrametat|
tasmin vam yamah pitribhih samvidanah pakvaya sharma bahulam ni yachchhat ||
verses.en: Attaining unto the southern quarter, turn ye (du.) about unto this vessel; in it shall Yama, in concord with the Fathers, assure abundant protection unto your cooked [offering].

verses.sa:
प्रतीची दिशामियमिद्वरं यस्यां सोमो अधिपा मृडिता च ।
तस्यां श्रयेथां सुकृतः सचेथामधा पक्वान् मिथुना सं भवाथः ॥
verses.rom:
pratichi dishamiyamidvaram yasyam somo adhipa mridita cha |
tasyam shrayetham sukritah sachethamadha pakvan mithuna sam bhavathah ||
verses.en: This western of the quarters verily is a thing to be preferred, in which Soma is over-ruler and favorer; to it resort (çri) ye (du.); attach yourselves to the well-doers; then, O paired ones, shall ye come into being from what is cooked.

verses.sa:
उत्तरं राष्ट्रं प्रजयोत्तरावद्दिशामुदीची कृणवन् नो अग्रम् ।
पाङ्क्तं छन्दः पुरुषो बभूव विश्वैर्विश्वाङ्गैः सह सं भवेम ॥
verses.rom:
uttaram rashtram prajayottaravaddishamudichi krinavan no agram |
panktam chhandah purusho babhuva vishvairvishvangaih saha sam bhavema ||
verses.en: A superior realm, having superiority by progeny, may the northern of the quarters make our (pl.) apex (? ágra); a five-fold (pā́n̄ta) meter hath the man become; may we come into being together with all, having all their limbs.

verses.sa:
ध्रुवेयं विराण्नमो अस्त्वस्यै शिवा पुत्रेभ्य उत मह्यमस्तु ।
सा नो देव्यदिते विश्ववार इर्य इव गोपा अभि रक्ष पक्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
dhruveyam virannamo astvasyai shiva putrebhya uta mahyamastu |
sa no devyadite vishvavara irya iva gopa abhi raksha pakvam ||
verses.en: This fixed [quarter] is virā́j; homage be to it; let it be propitious to [my] sons and to me; do thou, O goddess Aditi, having all choice things, like an active herdsman defend our cooked [offering].

verses.sa:
पितेव पुत्रान् अभि सं स्वजस्व नः शिवा नो वाता इह वान्तु भूमौ ।
यमोदनं पचतो देवते इह तं नस्तप उत सत्यं च वेत्तु ॥
verses.rom:
piteva putran abhi sam svajasva nah shiva no vata iha vantu bhumau |
yamodanam pachato devate iha tam nastapa uta satyam cha vettu ||
verses.en: Do thou embrace us, as a father his sons; let propitious winds blow here for us on the earth; what rice-dish the two deities cook here, let that know our penance and also truth.

verses.sa:
यद्यद्कृष्णः शकुन एह गत्वा त्सरन् विषक्तं बिल आससाद ।
यद्वा दास्यार्द्रहस्ता समङ्क्त उलूखलं मुसलं शुम्भतापः ॥
verses.rom:
yadyadkrishnah shakuna eha gatva tsaran vishaktam bila asasada |
yadva dasyardrahasta samankta ulukhalam musalam shumbhatapah ||
verses.en: Whenever the black bird, coming hither, hath sat upon the orifice, surprising (tsar) what is resolved (vi-sañj), or when the barbarian woman (dāsī́) with wet hands smears over—cleanse, ye waters, the mortar [and] pestle.

verses.sa:
अयं ग्रावा पृथुबुध्नो वयोधाः पूतः पवित्रैरप हन्तु रक्षः ।
आ रोह चर्म महि शर्म यच्छ मा दंपती पौत्रमघं नि गाताम् ॥
verses.rom:
ayam grava prithubudhno vayodhah putah pavitrairapa hantu rakshah |
a roha charma mahi sharma yachchha ma dampati pautramagham ni gatam ||
verses.en: Let this pressing-stone, broad-based, vigor-bestowing, purified by purifiers, smite away the demon; mount thou the hide; yield great protection; let not the husband-and-wife fall into evil proceeding from sons (pāútra).

verses.sa:
वनस्पतिः सह देवैर्न आगन् रक्षः पिशाचामपबाधमानः ।
स उच्छ्रयातै प्र वदाति वाचं तेन लोकामभि सर्वान् जयेम ॥
verses.rom:
vanaspatih saha devairna agan rakshah pishachamapabadhamanah |
sa uchchhrayatai pra vadati vacham tena lokamabhi sarvan jayema ||
verses.en: The forest tree hath come to us together with the gods, forcing off the demon, the piçācás; he shall rise up (ut-çri), shall speak forth his voice; with him may we conquer all worlds.

verses.sa:
सप्त मेधान् पशवः पर्यगृह्णन् य एषां ज्योतिष्माँ उत यश्चकर्श ।
त्रयस्त्रिंशद्देवतास्तान्त्सचन्ते स नः स्वर्गमभि नेष लोकम् ॥
verses.rom:
sapta medhan pashavah paryagrihnan ya esham jyotishman uta yashchakarsha |
trayastrimshaddevatastantsachante sa nah svargamabhi nesha lokam ||
verses.en: Seven sacrifices (médha) the cattle enclosed—which the relative pronoun of them was full of light, and which was pining; to them thirty deities attach themselves; do thou (m.) conduct us (pl.) unto the heavenly (svargá) world.

verses.sa:
स्वर्गं लोकमभि नो नयासि सं जायया सह पुत्रैः स्याम ।
गृह्णामि हस्तमनु मैत्वत्र मा नस्तारीन् निर्ऋतिर्मो अरातिः ॥
verses.rom:
svargam lokamabhi no nayasi sam jayaya saha putraih syama |
grihnami hastamanu maitvatra ma nastarin nirritirmo aratih ||
verses.en: Unto the heavenly world shalt thou conduct us (pl.); may we be united with wife, with sons; I grasp [her (?)] hand; let her (?) come here after me; let not destruction pass us, nor the niggard.

verses.sa:
ग्राहिं पाप्मानमति तामयाम तमो व्यस्य प्र वदासि वल्गु ।
वानस्पत्य उद्यतो मा जिहिंसीर्मा तण्डुलं वि शरीर्देवयन्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
grahim papmanamati tamayama tamo vyasya pra vadasi valgu |
vanaspatya udyato ma jihimsirma tandulam vi sharirdevayantam ||
verses.en: The seizure (grā́hi), evil (pāpmán)—may we go beyond them (pl.); dissipate thou the darkness; mayest thou speak forth what is agreeable; made of forest tree, uplifted, do not injure; do not crush to pieces vi-çṛ the god-loving rice-grain.

verses.sa:
विश्वव्यचा घृतपृष्ठो भविष्यन्त्सयोनिर्लोकमुप याह्येतम् ।
वर्षवृद्धमुप यच्छ शूर्पं तुषं पलावान् अप तद्विनक्तु ॥
verses.rom:
vishvavyacha ghritaprishtho bhavishyantsayonirlokamupa yahyetam |
varshavriddhamupa yachchha shurpam tusham palavan apa tadvinaktu ||
verses.en: About to become all-expanded, ghee-backed, go thou, of like origin (sáyoni), unto that world; hand thou (upa-yam) the rain-increased sieve; let that winnow away the husk, the chaff.

verses.sa:
त्रयो लोकाः संमिता ब्राह्मणेन द्यौरेवासौ पृथिव्यन्तरिक्षम् ।
अंशून् गृभीत्वान्वारभेथामा प्यायन्तां पुनरा यन्तु शूर्पम् ॥
verses.rom:
trayo lokah sammita brahmanena dyaurevasau prithivyantariksham |
amshun gribhitvanvarabhethama pyayantam punara yantu shurpam ||
verses.en: The three worlds are commensurate with the brā́hmaṇa: yon heaven, namely, earth, atmosphere; having seized the [soma-] stalks, take ye (du.) hold after; let them swell up (ā-pyā); let them come again to the sieve.

verses.sa:
पृथग्रूपाणि बहुधा पशूनामेकरूपो भवसि सं समृद्ध्या ।
एतां त्वचं लोहिनीं तां नुदस्व ग्रावा शुम्भाति मलग इव वस्त्रा ॥
verses.rom:
prithagrupani bahudha pashunamekarupo bhavasi sam samriddhya |
etam tvacham lohinim tam nudasva grava shumbhati malaga iva vastra ||
verses.en: Manifoldly separate [are] the forms of cattle; thou becomest one-formed together with success; that red skin—that thrust thou [away]; the pressing-stone shall cleanse like a fuller (? malagá) the garments.

verses.sa:
पृथिवीं त्वा पृथिव्यामा वेशयामि तनूः समानी विकृता त एषा ।
यद्यद्द्युत्तं लिखितमर्पणेन तेन मा सुस्रोर्ब्रह्मणापि तद्वपामि ॥
verses.rom:
prithivim tva prithivyama veshayami tanuh samani vikrita ta esha |
yadyaddyuttam likhitamarpanena tena ma susrorbrahmanapi tadvapami ||
verses.en: Thee that art earth I make enter into earth; this like body of thee [is] separated; whatever of thee is burnt (? dyuttá), [or] scratched by driving (árpaṇa); with that do not leak; I cover that over by a spell (bráhman).

verses.sa:
जनित्रीव प्रति हर्यासि सूनुं सं त्वा दधामि पृथिवीं पृथिव्या ।
उखा कुम्भी वेद्यां मा व्यथिष्ठा यज्ञायुधैराज्येनातिषक्ता ॥
verses.rom:
janitriva prati haryasi sunum sam tva dadhami prithivim prithivya |
ukha kumbhi vedyam ma vyathishtha yajnayudhairajyenatishakta ||
verses.en: Mayest thou welcome as a mother a son; I unite (sam-dhā) thee that art earth with the earth; a kettle, a vessel, do not stagger upon the sacrificial hearth, overhung by the implements of offering [and] by sacrificial butter.

verses.sa:
अग्निः पचन् रक्षतु त्वा पुरस्तादिन्द्रो रक्षतु दक्षिणतो मरुत्वान् ।
वरुणस्त्वा दृंहाद्धरुणे प्रतीच्या उत्तरात्त्वा सोमः सं ददातै ॥
verses.rom:
agnih pachan rakshatu tva purastadindro rakshatu dakshinato marutvan |
varunastva drimhaddharune pratichya uttarattva somah sam dadatai ||
verses.en: Let Agni, cooking, defend thee on the east; let Indra, with the Maruts, defend on the south; may Varuṇa fix thee in the maintenance (dharúṇa) of the western [quarter]; on the north may Soma give thee together.

verses.sa:
पूताः पवित्रैः पवन्ते अभ्राद्दिवं च यन्ति पृथिवीं च लोकान् ।
ता जीवला जीवधन्याः प्रतिष्ठाः पात्र आसिक्ताः पर्यग्निरिन्धाम् ॥
verses.rom:
putah pavitraih pavante abhraddivam cha yanti prithivim cha lokan |
ta jivala jivadhanyah pratishthah patra asiktah paryagnirindham ||
verses.en: Purified with purifiers, they purify themselves from the cloud; they go both to heaven and to earth [as their] worlds; them, lively, rich in life, firm-standing, poured into the vessel (pā́tra), let the fire kindle about.

verses.sa:
आ यन्ति दिवः पृथिवीं सचन्ते भूम्याः सचन्ते अध्यन्तरिक्षम् ।
शुद्धाः सतीस्ता उ शुम्भन्त एव ता नः स्वर्गमभि लोकं नयन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
a yanti divah prithivim sachante bhumyah sachante adhyantariksham |
shuddhah satista u shumbhanta eva ta nah svargamabhi lokam nayantu ||
verses.en: They come from the sky, they fasten on (sac) the earth; from the earth they fasten upon the atmosphere; being cleansed, they just cleanse themselves; let them conduct us to the heavenly world.

verses.sa:
उतेव प्रभ्वीरुत संमितास उत शुक्राः शुचयश्चामृतासः ।
ता ओदनं दंपतिभ्यां प्रशिष्टा आपः शिक्षन्तीः पचता सुनाथाः ॥
verses.rom:
uteva prabhviruta sammitasa uta shukrah shuchayashchamritasah |
ta odanam dampatibhyam prashishta apah shikshantih pachata sunathah ||
verses.en: Both as it were prevailing (prabhú) and also commensurate, also bright and clean, immortal—as such do ye, O waters, directed, helping, cook the rich-dish for the two spouses, ye of good refuge.

verses.sa:
संख्याता स्तोकाः पृथिवीं सचन्ते प्राणापानैः संमिता ओषधीभिः ।
असंख्याता ओप्यमानाः सुवर्णाः सर्वं व्यापुः शुचयः शुचित्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
samkhyata stokah prithivim sachante pranapanaih sammita oshadhibhih |
asamkhyata opyamanah suvarnah sarvam vyapuh shuchayah shuchitvam ||
verses.en: The numbered drops (stoká) fasten on the earth, being commensurate with breaths-and-expirations, with herbs; being scattered on, unnumbered, of good color, the clean ones have obtained all cleanness.

verses.sa:
उद्योधन्त्यभि वल्गन्ति तप्ताः फेनमस्यन्ति बहुलांश्च बिन्दून् ।
योषेव दृष्ट्वा पतिमृत्वियायैतैस्तण्डुलैर्भवता समापः ॥
verses.rom:
udyodhantyabhi valganti taptah phenamasyanti bahulamshcha bindun |
yosheva drishtva patimritviyayaitaistandulairbhavata samapah ||
verses.en: They struggle up (ud-yudh), they dance on, being heated; they hurl foam and abundant drops (bindú); like a woman that is in her season, seeing her husband, unite yourselves, O waters, with these rice-grains.

verses.sa:
उत्थापय सीदतो बुध्न एनान् अद्भिरात्मानमभि सं स्पृशन्ताम् ।
अमासि पात्रैरुदकं यदेतन् मितास्तण्डुलाः प्रदिशो यदीमाः ॥
verses.rom:
utthapaya sidato budhna enan adbhiratmanamabhi sam sprishantam |
amasi patrairudakam yadetan mitastandulah pradisho yadimah ||
verses.en: Make thou them stand up, as they sit on the bottom; let them touch themselves all over with the waters; I have measured with vessels (pā́tra) the water that is here; measured are the rice-grains that are these directions.

verses.sa:
प्र यच्छ पर्शुं त्वरया हरौषमहिंसन्त ओषधीर्दान्तु पर्वन् ।
यासां सोमः परि राज्यं बभूवामन्युता नो वीरुधो भवन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
pra yachchha parshum tvaraya haraushamahimsanta oshadhirdantu parvan |
yasam somah pari rajyam babhuvamanyuta no virudho bhavantu ||
verses.en: Reach thou forth the sickle (párçu), hasten, take [it] quickly; let them, not harming, cut (dā) the herbs at the joint; they of whom Soma compassed the kingship—let the plants be without wrath toward us.

verses.sa:
नवं बर्हिरोदनाय स्तृणीत प्रियं हृदश्चक्षुषो वल्ग्वस्तु ।
तस्मिन् देवाः सह दैवीर्विशन्त्विमं प्राश्नन्त्वृतुभिर्निषद्य ॥
verses.rom:
navam barhirodanaya strinita priyam hridashchakshusho valgvastu |
tasmin devah saha daivirvishantvimam prashnantvritubhirnishadya ||
verses.en: Strew ye a new barhís for the rice-dish; be it dear to the heart, agreeable to the eye; on it let the gods [and] the divine ones (f.) settle (viç) together; sitting down (ni-sad), let them partake of this with the seasons.

verses.sa:
वनस्पते स्तीर्णमा सीद बर्हिरग्निष्टोमैः संमितो देवताभिः ।
त्वष्ट्रेव रूपं सुकृतं स्वधित्यैना एहाः परि पात्रे ददृश्राम् ॥
verses.rom:
vanaspate stirnama sida barhiragnishtomaih sammito devatabhih |
tvashtreva rupam sukritam svadhityaina ehah pari patre dadrishram ||
verses.en: O forest tree, sit on the strewn barhís, being commensurate with the Agni-praises (agniṣṭomá), with the deities; like a form well made by an artisan (tváṣṭṛ) with a knife, so (enā́) let the eager ones be seen round about in the vessel (pā́tra).

verses.sa:
षष्ट्यां शरत्सु निधिपा अभीच्छात्स्वः पक्वेनाभ्यश्नवातै ।
उपैनं जीवान् पितरश्च पुत्रा एतं स्वर्गं गमयान्तमग्नेः ॥
verses.rom:
shashtyam sharatsu nidhipa abhichchhatsvah pakvenabhyashnavatai |
upainam jivan pitarashcha putra etam svargam gamayantamagneh ||
verses.en: In sixty autumns may he (?) seek unto the treasure-keepers; may he attain unto the sky with the cooked [offering]; may both fathers [and] sons live upon him; make thou this one to go unto the heaven-going end of the fire.

verses.sa:
धर्ता ध्रियस्व धरुणे पृथिव्या अच्युतं त्वा देवताश्च्यावयन्तु ।
तं त्वा दंपती जीवन्तौ जीवपुत्रावुद्वासयातः पर्यग्निधानात् ॥
verses.rom:
dharta dhriyasva dharune prithivya achyutam tva devatashchyavayantu |
tam tva dampati jivantau jivaputravudvasayatah paryagnidhanat ||
verses.en: A maintainer, maintain thyself in the maintenance of the earth; thee that art unmoved let the deities make to move (cyu); thee shall the two spouses, living, having living sons, cause to remove (ud-vas) out of the fire-holder.

verses.sa:
सर्वान्त्समागा अभिजित्य लोकान् यावन्तः कामाः समतीतृपस्तान् ।
वि गाहेथामायवनं च दर्विरेकस्मिन् पात्रे अध्युद्धरैनम् ॥
verses.rom:
sarvantsamaga abhijitya lokan yavantah kamah samatitripastan |
vi gahethamayavanam cha darvirekasmin patre adhyuddharainam ||
verses.en: Thou hast come together unto all the worlds, having conquered; however many [be] the desires, thou hast made them wholly satisfied; plunge ye (du.) in—both the stirring-stick [and] the spoon; take thou him up upon one vessel.

verses.sa:
उप स्तृणीहि प्रथय पुरस्ताद्घृतेन पात्रमभि घारयैतत्।
वाश्रेवोस्रा तरुणं स्तनस्युमिमं देवासो अभिहिङ्कृणोत ॥
verses.rom:
upa strinihi prathaya purastadghritena patramabhi gharayaitat|
vashrevosra tarunam stanasyumimam devaso abhihinkrinota ||
verses.en: Strew thou on, spread forward, smear over with ghee this vessel; as a lowing cow (usrā́) [toward] a young [calf] desiring the teat, do ye, O gods, utter the sound hing toward this one.

verses.sa:
उपास्तरीरकरो लोकमेतमुरुः प्रथतामसमः स्वर्गः ।
तस्मिं छ्रयातै महिषः सुपर्णो देवा एनं देवताभ्यः प्र यछान् ॥
verses.rom:
upastarirakaro lokametamuruh prathatamasamah svargah |
tasmim chhrayatai mahishah suparno deva enam devatabhyah pra yachhan ||
verses.en: Thou hast strewn on, hast made that world; let the broad unequalled heavenly world (svargá) spread itself out; to it shall resort (çri) the mighty eagle; the gods shall reach him forth to the deities.

verses.sa:
यद्यज्जाया पचति त्वत्परःपरः पतिर्वा जाये त्वत्तिरः ।
सं तत्सृजेथां सह वां तदस्तु संपादयन्तौ सह लोकमेकम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadyajjaya pachati tvatparahparah patirva jaye tvattirah |
sam tatsrijetham saha vam tadastu sampadayantau saha lokamekam ||
verses.en: What in any case thy wife cooks beyond thee, or thy husband, O wife, in secret from thee, that do ye unite; that be yours together; agreeing (? sampāday-) together upon one world.

verses.sa:
यावन्तो अस्याः पृथिवीं सचन्ते अस्मत्पुत्राः परि ये संबभूवुः ।
सर्वांस्तामुप पात्रे ह्वयेथां नाभिं जानानाः शिशवः समायान् ॥
verses.rom:
yavanto asyah prithivim sachante asmatputrah pari ye sambabhuvuh |
sarvamstamupa patre hvayetham nabhim jananah shishavah samayan ||
verses.en: How many of her fasten on (sac) the earth, what sons came forth into being from us (pl.)—all those do ye (du.) call to you in the vessel;. knowing the navel, the young ones (çíçu) shall come together.

verses.sa:
वसोर्या धारा मधुना प्रपीना घृतेन मिश्रा अमृतस्य नाभयः ।
सर्वास्ता अव रुन्धे स्वर्गः षष्ट्यां शरत्सु निधिपा अभीछात् ॥
verses.rom:
vasorya dhara madhuna prapina ghritena mishra amritasya nabhayah |
sarvasta ava rundhe svargah shashtyam sharatsu nidhipa abhichhat ||
verses.en: What streams (dhā́rā) of good (vásu) [there are], fattened with honey, mixed with ghee, navels of immortality—all those doth the heaven-goer (? svargá) take possession of; in sixty autumns may he seek unto the treasure-keepers.

verses.sa:
निधिं निधिपा अभ्येनमिछादनीश्वरा अभितः सन्तु येऽन्ये ।
अस्माभिर्दत्तो निहितः स्वर्गस्त्रिभिः काण्डैस्त्रीन्त्स्वर्गान् अरुक्षत् ॥
verses.rom:
nidhim nidhipa abhyenamichhadanishvara abhitah santu ye'nye |
asmabhirdatto nihitah svargastribhih kandaistrintsvargan arukshat ||
verses.en: He shall seek unto it, [as] treasure-keepers unto a treasure; let those who are others be not lords (ánīçvara) about; given by us, deposited, heaven-going, with three divisions it has ascended to three heavens (svargá).

verses.sa:
अग्नी रक्षस्तपतु यद्विदेवं क्रव्याद्पिशाच इह मा प्र पास्त ।
नुदाम एनमप रुध्मो अस्मदादित्या एनमङ्गिरसः सचन्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
agni rakshastapatu yadvidevam kravyadpishacha iha ma pra pasta |
nudama enamapa rudhmo asmadaditya enamangirasah sachantam ||
verses.en: Let Agni burn the demon that is godless; let the flesh-eating piçācá not have a draught here; we thrust him, we bar him away from us; let the Ādityas, the An̄girases, fasten on him.

verses.sa:
आदित्येभ्यो अङ्गिरोभ्यो मध्विदं घृतेन मिश्रं प्रति वेदयामि ।
शुद्धहस्तौ ब्राह्मणस्यानिहत्यैतं स्वर्गं सुकृतावपीतम् ॥
verses.rom:
adityebhyo angirobhyo madhvidam ghritena mishram prati vedayami |
shuddhahastau brahmanasyanihatyaitam svargam sukritavapitam ||
verses.en: To the Ādityas, the An̄girases, I announce this honey mingled with ghee; with cleansed hands, not smiting down [anything of] the Brahman's, go ye (du.), O well-doers, unto this heavenly world (svargá).

verses.sa:
इदं प्रापमुत्तमं काण्डमस्य यस्माल्लोकात्परमेष्ठी समाप ।
आ सिञ्च सर्पिर्घृतवत्समङ्ग्ध्येष भागो अङ्गिरसो नो अत्र ॥
verses.rom:
idam prapamuttamam kandamasya yasmallokatparameshthi samapa |
a sincha sarpirghritavatsamangdhyesha bhago angiraso no atra ||
verses.en: I have obtained this highest division of it, from which world the most exalted one obtained [it] completely; pour thou on the butter (sarpís); anoint with ghee; this is the portion of our An̄giras here.

verses.sa:
सत्याय च तपसे देवताभ्यो निधिं शेवधिं परि दद्म एतम् ।
मा नो द्यूतेऽव गान् मा समित्यां मा स्मान्यस्मा उत्सृजता पुरा मत् ॥
verses.rom:
satyaya cha tapase devatabhyo nidhim shevadhim pari dadma etam |
ma no dyute'va gan ma samityam ma smanyasma utsrijata pura mat ||
verses.en: Unto truth, unto penance, and unto the deities, we deliver this deposit (nidhí), [this] treasure (çevadhí); let it not be lost (ava-gā) in our play, nor in the meeting; do not ye release it to another in preference to (purā́) me.

verses.sa:
अहं पचाम्यहं ददामि ममेदु कर्मन् करुणेऽधि जाया ।
कौमारो लोको अजनिष्ट पुत्रोऽन्वारभेथां वय उत्तरावत् ॥
verses.rom:
aham pachamyaham dadami mamedu karman karune'dhi jaya |
kaumaro loko ajanishta putro'nvarabhetham vaya uttaravat ||
verses.en: I cook; I give; verily upon my action [and] deed (? karúṇa) the wife; a virgin (? kāúmāra) world hath been born, a son; take ye (du.) hold after vigor (váyas) that hath what is superior.

verses.sa:
न किल्बिषमत्र नाधारो अस्ति न यन् मित्रैः समममान एति ।
अनूनं पात्रं निहितं न एतत्पक्तारं पक्वः पुनरा विशाति ॥
verses.rom:
na kilbishamatra nadharo asti na yan mitraih samamamana eti |
anunam patram nihitam na etatpaktaram pakvah punara vishati ||
verses.en: No offense is here, nor support (? ādhārá), nor that one goes agreeing (sam-am) with friends; this vessel of ours is set down not empty; the cooked [dish] shall enter again him that cooked it.

verses.sa:
प्रियं प्रियाणां कृणवाम तमस्ते यन्तु यतमे द्विषन्ति ।
धेनुरनड्वान् वयोवय आयदेव पौरुषेयमप मृत्युं नुदन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
priyam priyanam krinavama tamaste yantu yatame dvishanti |
dhenuranadvan vayovaya ayadeva paurusheyamapa mrityum nudantu ||
verses.en: May we do what is dear to them that are dear; whosoever hate [us], let them go to darkness; milch-cow, draft-ox, each coming vigor (váyas)—let them thrust away the death that comes from men.

verses.sa:
समग्नयः विदुरन्यो अन्यं य ओषधीः सचते यश्च सिन्धून् ।
यावन्तो देवा दिव्यातपन्ति हिरण्यं ज्योतिः पचतो बभूव ॥
verses.rom:
samagnayah viduranyo anyam ya oshadhih sachate yashcha sindhun |
yavanto deva divyatapanti hiranyam jyotih pachato babhuva ||
verses.en: The fires ire in concord, one with another—he that fastens on the herbs, and he that [fastens on] the rivers; as many gods as send heat (ā-tap) in the sky—gold hath become the light of him that cooks.

verses.sa:
एषा त्वचां पुरुषे सं बभूवानग्नाः सर्वे पशवो ये अन्ये ।
क्षत्रेणात्मानं परि धापयाथोऽमोतं वासो मुखमोदनस्य ॥
verses.rom:
esha tvacham purushe sam babhuvanagnah sarve pashavo ye anye |
kshatrenatmanam pari dhapayatho'motam vaso mukhamodanasya ||
verses.en: This one of skins (tvác) hath come into being on man; not naked are all the animals (paçú) that are other; ye (du.) cause to wrap (paridhā) yourselves (ātmán) with authority (kṣatrá), a home-woven garment, the mouth of the rice-dish.

verses.sa:
यदक्षेषु वदा यत्समित्यां यद्वा वदा अनृतं वित्तकाम्या ।
समानं तन्तुमभि सम्वसानौ तस्मिन्त्सर्वं शमलं सादयाथः ॥
verses.rom:
yadaksheshu vada yatsamityam yadva vada anritam vittakamya |
samanam tantumabhi samvasanau tasmintsarvam shamalam sadayathah ||
verses.en: What [untruth] thou shalt speak at the dice, what at the meeting, or what untruth thou shalt speak from desire of gain—clothing yourselves (du.) in the same web (tántu), ye shall settle in it all pollution.

verses.sa:
वर्षं वनुष्वापि गच्छ देवांस्त्वचो धूमं पर्युत्पातयासि ।
विश्वव्यचा घृतपृष्ठो भविष्यन्त्सयोनिर्लोकमुप याह्येतम् ॥
verses.rom:
varsham vanushvapi gachchha devamstvacho dhumam paryutpatayasi |
vishvavyacha ghritaprishtho bhavishyantsayonirlokamupa yahyetam ||
verses.en: Win thou rain; go unto the gods; thou shalt make smoke fly up out of the skin; about to become all-expanded, ghee-backed, go thou, of like origin, unto that world.

verses.sa:
तन्वं स्वर्गो बहुधा वि चक्रे यथा विद आत्मन्न् अन्यवर्णाम् ।
अपाजैत्कृष्णां रुशतीं पुनानो या लोहिनी तां ते अग्नौ जुहोमि ॥
verses.rom:
tanvam svargo bahudha vi chakre yatha vida atmann anyavarnam |
apajaitkrishnam rushatim punano ya lohini tam te agnau juhomi ||
verses.en: The heaven-goer hath variously changed his body, as he finds (? vidé) in himself one of another color; he hath conquered off the black one, purifying a shining one (rúçat); the one that is red, that I offer (hu) to thee in the fire.

verses.sa:
प्राच्यै त्वा दिशेऽग्नयेऽधिपतयेऽसिताय रक्षित्र आदित्यायेषुमते ।
एतं परि दद्मस्तं नो गोपायतास्माकमैतोः ।
दिष्टं नो अत्र जरसे नि नेषज्जरा मृत्यवे परि णो ददात्वथ पक्वेन सह सं भवेम ॥
verses.rom:
prachyai tva dishe'gnaye'dhipataye'sitaya rakshitra adityayeshumate |
etam pari dadmastam no gopayatasmakamaitoh |
dishtam no atra jarase ni neshajjara mrityave pari no dadatvatha pakvena saha sam bhavema ||
verses.en: To the eastern quarter, to Agni as overlord, to the black [serpent] as defender, to Āditya having arrows, we commit thee here; guard ye him for us until our coming; may he lead on our appointed [life-time] here unto old age; let old age commit us unto death; then may we be united with the cooked [offering].

verses.sa:
दक्षिणायै त्वा दिश इन्द्रायाधिपतये तिरश्चिराजये रक्षित्रे यमायेषुमते ।
एतं परि दद्मस्तं नो गोपायतास्माकमैतोः ।
दिष्टं नो अत्र जरसे नि नेषज्जरा मृत्यवे परि णो ददात्वथ पक्वेन सह सं भवेम ॥
verses.rom:
dakshinayai tva disha indrayadhipataye tirashchirajaye rakshitre yamayeshumate |
etam pari dadmastam no gopayatasmakamaitoh |
dishtam no atra jarase ni neshajjara mrityave pari no dadatvatha pakvena saha sam bhavema ||
