verses.en: To the southern quarter, to Indra as overlord, to the cross-lined [serpent] as defender, to Yama having arrows, we commit thee here; guard ye etc. etc.

verses.sa:
प्रतीच्यै त्वा दिशे वरुणायाधिपतये पृदाकवे रक्षित्रेऽन्नायेषुमते ।
एतं परि दद्मस्तं नो गोपायतास्माकमैतोः ।
दिष्टं नो अत्र जरसे नि नेषज्जरा मृत्यवे परि णो ददात्वथ पक्वेन सह सं भवेम ॥
verses.rom:
pratichyai tva dishe varunayadhipataye pridakave rakshitre'nnayeshumate |
etam pari dadmastam no gopayatasmakamaitoh |
dishtam no atra jarase ni neshajjara mrityave pari no dadatvatha pakvena saha sam bhavema ||
verses.en: To the western quarter, to Varuṇa as overlord, to the pṛ́dāku as defender, to food having arrows, we commit thee here; guard ye etc. etc.

verses.sa:
उदीच्यै त्वा दिशे सोमायाधिपतये स्वजाय रक्षित्रेऽशन्या इषुमत्यै ।
एतं परि दद्मस्तं नो गोपायतास्माकमैतोः ।
दिष्टं नो अत्र जरसे नि नेषज्जरा मृत्यवे परि णो ददात्वथ पक्वेन सह सं भवेम ॥
verses.rom:
udichyai tva dishe somayadhipataye svajaya rakshitre'shanya ishumatyai |
etam pari dadmastam no gopayatasmakamaitoh |
dishtam no atra jarase ni neshajjara mrityave pari no dadatvatha pakvena saha sam bhavema ||
verses.en: To the northern quarter, to Soma as overlord, to the constrictor as defender, to the thunderbolt having arrows, we commit thee here; guard ye etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ध्रुवायै त्वा दिशे विष्णवेऽधिपतये कल्माषग्रीवाय रक्षित्र ओषधीभ्य इषुमतीभ्यः ।
एतं परि दद्मस्तं नो गोपायतास्माकमैतोः ।
दिष्टं नो अत्र जरसे नि नेषज्जरा मृत्यवे परि णो ददात्वथ पक्वेन सह सं भवेम ॥
verses.rom:
dhruvayai tva dishe vishnave'dhipataye kalmashagrivaya rakshitra oshadhibhya ishumatibhyah |
etam pari dadmastam no gopayatasmakamaitoh |
dishtam no atra jarase ni neshajjara mrityave pari no dadatvatha pakvena saha sam bhavema ||
verses.en: To the fixed quarter, to Vishṇu as overlord, to the spotted-necked [serpent] as defender, to the herbs having arrows, we commit thee here; guard ye etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वायै त्वा दिशे बृहस्पतयेऽधिपतये श्वित्राय रक्षित्रे वर्षायेषुमते ।
एतं परि दद्मस्तं नो गोपायतास्माकमैतोः ।
दिष्टं नो अत्र जरसे नि नेषज्जरा मृत्यवे परि णो ददात्वथ पक्वेन सह सं भवेम ॥
verses.rom:
urdhvayai tva dishe brihaspataye'dhipataye shvitraya rakshitre varshayeshumate |
etam pari dadmastam no gopayatasmakamaitoh |
dishtam no atra jarase ni neshajjara mrityave pari no dadatvatha pakvena saha sam bhavema ||
verses.en: To the upward quarter, to Brihaspati as overlord, to the white [serpent] as defender, to rain having arrows, we commit thee here; guard ye etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ददामीत्येव ब्रूयादनु चैनामभुत्सत ।
वशां ब्रह्मभ्यो याचद्भ्यस्तत्प्रजावदपत्यवत् ॥
verses.rom:
dadamityeva bruyadanu chainamabhutsata |
vasham brahmabhyo yachadbhyastatprajavadapatyavat ||
verses.en: I give [her]—thus should he say, if they have noticed (? anu-budh) her—[I give] the cow (vaçā́) to the priests (brahmán) that ask for her; that brings progeny, descendants.

verses.sa:
प्रजया स वि क्रीणीते पशुभिश्चोप दस्यति ।
य आर्षेयेभ्यो याचद्भ्यो देवानां गां न दित्सति ॥
verses.rom:
prajaya sa vi krinite pashubhishchopa dasyati |
ya arsheyebhyo yachadbhyo devanam gam na ditsati ||
verses.en: He bargains away his progeny and becomes exhausted of cattle who is not willing to give the cow (gó) of the gods to the sons of seers that ask for her.

verses.sa:
कूटयास्य सं शीर्यन्ते श्लोणया काटमर्दति ।
बण्डया दह्यन्ते गृहाः काणया दीयते स्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
kutayasya sam shiryante shlonaya katamardati |
bandaya dahyante grihah kanaya diyate svam ||
verses.en: By a hornless one they are crushed for him; by a lame one he falls (? ard) into a pit; by a crippled one his houses are burned; by a one-eyed one his possessions are taken away (?).

verses.sa:
विलोहितो अधिष्ठानाच्छक्नो विन्दति गोपतिम् ।
तथा वशायाः संविद्यं दुरदभ्ना ह्युच्यसे ॥
verses.rom:
vilohito adhishthanachchhakno vindati gopatim |
tatha vashayah samvidyam duradabhna hyuchyase ||
verses.en: Anæmia (vilohitá) from the station of the dung visits (vid) the master of kine; so is the agreement (?) of the cow; for door-damaging (?) art thou called.

verses.sa:
पदोरस्या अधिष्ठानाद्विक्लिन्दुर्नाम विन्दति ।
अनामनात्सं शीर्यन्ते या मुखेनोपजिघ्रति ॥
verses.rom:
padorasya adhishthanadviklindurnama vindati |
anamanatsam shiryante ya mukhenopajighrati ||
verses.en: From the station of the two feet of her, soaking (? viklíndu) namely visits [him]; unexpectedly (?) are they crushed who snuff at her with the mouth.

verses.sa:
यो अस्याः कर्णावास्कुनोत्या स देवेषु वृश्चते ।
लक्ष्म कुर्व इति मन्यते कनीयः कृणुते स्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
yo asyah karnavaskunotya sa deveshu vrishchate |
lakshma kurva iti manyate kaniyah krinute svam ||
verses.en: Whoever punches (ā-sku) the two ears of her, he falls under the wrath of the gods; if he thinks "I am making a mark," he makes his possessions less.

verses.sa:
यदस्याः कस्मै चिद्भोगाय बालान् कश्चित्प्रकृन्तति ।
ततः किशोरा म्रियन्ते वत्सांश्च घातुको वृकः ॥
verses.rom:
yadasyah kasmai chidbhogaya balan kashchitprakrintati |
tatah kishora mriyante vatsamshcha ghatuko vrikah ||
verses.en: If, for any one's advantage, any one cuts off the tail-tuft of her, then his colts die, and the wolf slays his calves.

verses.sa:
यदस्या गोपतौ सत्या लोम ध्वाङ्क्षो अजीहिडत्।
ततः कुमारा म्रियन्ते यक्ष्मो विन्दत्यनामनात् ॥
verses.rom:
yadasya gopatau satya loma dhvanksho ajihidat|
tatah kumara mriyante yakshmo vindatyanamanat ||
verses.en: If of her, while being with her master, a crow hath vexed (hīḍ) the hair, then his boys die, [and] the yákṣma visits him unexpectedly (?).

verses.sa:
यदस्याः पल्पूलनं शकृद्दासी समस्यति ।
ततोऽपरूपं जायते तस्मादव्येष्यदेनसः ॥
verses.rom:
yadasyah palpulanam shakriddasi samasyati |
tato'parupam jayate tasmadavyeshyadenasah ||
verses.en: If the lye, the dung of her a barbarian woman flings together, then is born what is deformed, what will not escape from that sin.

verses.sa:
जायमानाभि जायते देवान्त्सब्राह्मणान् वशा ।
तस्माद्ब्रह्मभ्यो देयैषा तदाहुः स्वस्य गोपनम् ॥
verses.rom:
jayamanabhi jayate devantsabrahmanan vasha |
tasmadbrahmabhyo deyaisha tadahuh svasya gopanam ||
verses.en: When being born, the cow (vaçā́) is born for (abhí) the gods together with the Brahmans; therefore she is to be given to the priests (brahmán); that people call the guarding (gópana) of one's possessions.

verses.sa:
य एनां वनिमायन्ति तेषां देवकृता वशा ।
ब्रह्मज्येयं तदब्रुवन् य एनां निप्रियायते ॥
verses.rom:
ya enam vanimayanti tesham devakrita vasha |
brahmajyeyam tadabruvan ya enam nipriyayate ||
verses.en: They who come to the winning (vaní) of her, theirs is the god-made cow vaçā́; they called it bráhman-scathing, if anyone keeps her to himself.

verses.sa:
य आर्षेयेभ्यो याचद्भ्यो देवानां गां न दित्सति ।
आ स देवेषु वृश्चते ब्राह्मणानां च मन्यवे ॥
verses.rom:
ya arsheyebhyo yachadbhyo devanam gam na ditsati |
a sa deveshu vrishchate brahmananam cha manyave ||
verses.en: Whoever is not willing to give the cow (gó) of the gods to the sons of seers that ask for her, he falls under the wrath of the gods and the fury of the Brahmans.

verses.sa:
यो अस्य स्याद्वशाभोगो अन्यामिछेत तर्हि सः ।
हिंस्ते अदत्ता पुरुषं याचितां च न दित्सति ॥
verses.rom:
yo asya syadvashabhogo anyamichheta tarhi sah |
himste adatta purusham yachitam cha na ditsati ||
verses.en: Whatever may be his use for the cow (vaçā́-), he should then seek another [cow]; she, ungiven, harms a man, if he is not willing to give her when asked for.

verses.sa:
यथा शेवधिर्निहितो ब्राह्मणानां तथा वशा ।
तामेतदछायन्ति यस्मिन् कस्मिंश्च जायते ॥
verses.rom:
yatha shevadhirnihito brahmananam tatha vasha |
tametadachhayanti yasmin kasmimshcha jayate ||
verses.en: As a deposited treasure (çevadhí), so of the Brahmans is the cow (vaçā́); accordingly etát they come unto her, in whosesoever possession she is born.

verses.sa:
स्वमेतदछायन्ति यद्वशां ब्राह्मणा अभि ।
यथैनान् अन्यस्मिन् जिनीयादेवास्या निरोधनम् ॥
verses.rom:
svametadachhayanti yadvasham brahmana abhi |
yathainan anyasmin jiniyadevasya nirodhanam ||
verses.en: They come thus unto their own property, namely the Brahmans unto the cow; as one might scathe them in any other respect (?), so is the keeping back of her.

verses.sa:
चरेदेवा त्रैहायणादविज्ञातगदा सती ।
वशां च विद्यान् नारद ब्राह्मणास्तर्ह्येष्याः ॥
verses.rom:
charedeva traihayanadavijnatagada sati |
vasham cha vidyan narada brahmanastarhyeshyah ||
verses.en: She may go about until ā́ the space of three years, being of unrecognized (vi-jñā) speech (-gada); should he know the cow, O Nārada, then the Brahmans are to be sought.

verses.sa:
य एनामवशामाह देवानां निहितं निधिम् ।
उभौ तस्मै भवाशर्वौ परिक्रम्येषुमस्यतः ॥
verses.rom:
ya enamavashamaha devanam nihitam nidhim |
ubhau tasmai bhavasharvau parikramyeshumasyatah ||
verses.en: Whoever declares her to be not the cow, the deposited deposit of the gods, at him Bhava-and-Çarva, both, striding about, hurl the arrow.

verses.sa:
यो अस्या ऊधो न वेदाथो अस्या स्तनान् उत ।
उभयेनैवास्मै दुहे दातुं चेदशकद्वशाम् ॥
verses.rom:
yo asya udho na vedatho asya stanan uta |
ubhayenaivasmai duhe datum chedashakadvasham ||
verses.en: Whoever knows not the udder of her, and likewise the teats of her, to him she yields milk with both, if he has been able to give the cow.

verses.sa:
दुरदभ्नैनमा शये याचितां च न दित्सति ।
नास्मै कामाः समृध्यन्ते यामदत्त्वा चिकीर्षति ॥
verses.rom:
duradabhnainama shaye yachitam cha na ditsati |
nasmai kamah samridhyante yamadattva chikirshati ||
verses.en: Door-damaging (?) lies she on him, if he is not willing to give her when asked for; he does not succeed in the desires which, without having given her, he would fain accomplish (cikīrṣa-).

verses.sa:
देवा वशामयाचन् मुखं कृत्वा ब्राह्मणम् ।
तेषां सर्वेषामददद्धेडं न्येति मानुषः ॥
verses.rom:
deva vashamayachan mukham kritva brahmanam |
tesham sarveshamadadaddhedam nyeti manushah ||
verses.en: The gods asked for the cow, having made the Brahman their mouth; the wrath (héḍa) of them all incurs (ni-i) the man (mā́nuṣa) who gives not.

verses.sa:
हेडं पशूनां न्येति ब्राह्मणेभ्योऽददद्वशाम् ।
देवानां निहितं भागं मर्त्यश्चेन् निप्रियायते ॥
verses.rom:
hedam pashunam nyeti brahmanebhyo'dadadvasham |
devanam nihitam bhagam martyashchen nipriyayate ||
verses.en: He incurs the wrath of cattle (paçú) who gives not the cow to the Brahmans—if a mortal keeps to himself the deposited portion of the gods.

verses.sa:
यदन्ये शतं याचेयुर्ब्राह्मणा गोपतिं वशाम् ।
अथैनां देवा अब्रुवन्न् एवं ह विदुषो वशा ॥
verses.rom:
yadanye shatam yacheyurbrahmana gopatim vasham |
athainam deva abruvann evam ha vidusho vasha ||
verses.en: If a hundred other Brahmans should ask the cow of its master, yet (átha) the gods said of her: the cow is his who knoweth thus.

verses.sa:
य एवं विदुषेऽदत्त्वाथान्येभ्यो ददद्वशाम् ।
दुर्गा तस्मा अधिष्ठाने पृथिवी सहदेवता ॥
verses.rom:
ya evam vidushe'dattvathanyebhyo dadadvasham |
durga tasma adhishthane prithivi sahadevata ||
verses.en: Whoever, not having given her to one who knoweth thus, then shall give the cow to others, hard to go upon for him in his station is the earth with its deity.

verses.sa:
देवा वशामयाचन् यस्मिन्न् अग्रे अजायत ।
तामेतां विद्यान् नारदः सह देवैरुदाजत ॥
verses.rom:
deva vashamayachan yasminn agre ajayata |
tametam vidyan naradah saha devairudajata ||
verses.en: The gods asked the cow [of him] in whose possession she was first (ágre) born; that same one may Nārada know; together with the gods he drove her away.

verses.sa:
अनपत्यमल्पपशुं वशा कृणोति पूरुषम् ।
ब्राह्मणैश्च याचितामथैनां निप्रियायते ॥
verses.rom:
anapatyamalpapashum vasha krinoti purusham |
brahmanaishcha yachitamathainam nipriyayate ||
verses.en: The cow makes a man (pū́ruṣa) destitute of descendants, poor in cattle, if, when she is asked for by the Brahmans, then he keeps her to himself.

verses.sa:
अग्नीषोमाभ्यां कामाय मित्राय वरुणाय च ।
तेभ्यो याचन्ति ब्राह्मणास्तेष्वा वृश्चतेऽददत् ॥
verses.rom:
agnishomabhyam kamaya mitraya varunaya cha |
tebhyo yachanti brahmanasteshva vrishchate'dadat ||
verses.en: For Agni-and-Soma, for Love (kā́ma), for Mitra and for Varuṇa—for these the Brahmans ask her; under their wrath falls he who gives not.

verses.sa:
यावदस्या गोपतिर्नोपशृणुयादृचः स्वयम् ।
चरेदस्य तावद्गोषु नास्य श्रुत्वा गृहे वसेत् ॥
verses.rom:
yavadasya gopatirnopashrinuyadrichah svayam |
charedasya tavadgoshu nasya shrutva grihe vaset ||
verses.en: So long as the master of her should not himself overhear the verses (ṛ́ç), so long may she go about among his kine (gó); she may not abide in his house after he has heard.

verses.sa:
यो अस्या ऋच उपश्रुत्याथ गोष्वचीचरत्।
आयुश्च तस्य भूतिं च देवा वृश्चन्ति हीडिताः ॥
verses.rom:
yo asya richa upashrutyatha goshvachicharat|
ayushcha tasya bhutim cha deva vrishchanti hiditah ||
verses.en: If any one, having overheard the verses of her, has then made her go about among his kine (gó), both the life-time and the growth of him do the gods, made wrathful, cut off (vraçc).

verses.sa:
वशा चरन्ती बहुधा देवानां निहितो निधिः ।
आविष्कृणुष्व रूपाणि यदा स्थाम जिघांसति ॥
verses.rom:
vasha charanti bahudha devanam nihito nidhih |
avishkrinushva rupani yada sthama jighamsati ||
verses.en: The cow, going about variously, the deposited deposit of the gods, manifests her forms, when she desires to go (?) to her station (sthā́man).

verses.sa:
आविरात्मानं कृणुते यदा स्थाम जिघांसति ।
अथो ह ब्रह्मभ्यो वशा याञ्च्याय कृणुते मनः ॥
verses.rom:
aviratmanam krinute yada sthama jighamsati |
atho ha brahmabhyo vasha yanchyaya krinute manah ||
verses.en: She manifests herself when she desires to go to her station; then the cow vaçā́ makes up her mind for the asking of the priests (brahmán).

verses.sa:
मनसा सं कल्पयति तद्देवामपि गच्छति ।
ततो ह ब्रह्माणो वशामुपप्रयन्ति याचितुम् ॥
verses.rom:
manasa sam kalpayati taddevamapi gachchhati |
tato ha brahmano vashamupaprayanti yachitum ||
verses.en: She plans (sam-kḷp) [it] with her mind; then she goes unto the gods; thence the priests (brahmán) go on to ask for the cow.

verses.sa:
स्वधाकारेण पितृभ्यो यज्ञेन देवताभ्यः ।
दानेन राजन्यो वशाया मातुर्हेडं न गच्छति ॥
verses.rom:
svadhakarena pitribhyo yajnena devatabhyah |
danena rajanyo vashaya maturhedam na gachchhati ||
verses.en: By offering of svadhā́ to the Fathers, by sacrifice to the deities, by giving of the cow, the noble (rājanyà) does not incur (gam) the mother's wrath.

verses.sa:
वशा माता राजन्यस्य तथा संभूतमग्रशः ।
तस्या आहुरनर्पणं यद्ब्रह्मभ्यः प्रदीयते ॥
verses.rom:
vasha mata rajanyasya tatha sambhutamagrashah |
tasya ahuranarpanam yadbrahmabhyah pradiyate ||
verses.en: The cow is mother of the noble; so came it (n.) into being in the beginning; they call it a non-abandonment (? ánarpaṇa) of her that she is presented to the priests (brahmán).

verses.sa:
यथाज्यं प्रगृहीतमालुम्पेत्स्रुचो अग्नये ।
एवा ह ब्रह्मभ्यो वशामग्नय आ वृश्चतेऽददत् ॥
verses.rom:
yathajyam pragrihitamalumpetsrucho agnaye |
eva ha brahmabhyo vashamagnaya a vrishchate'dadat ||
verses.en: As one might snatch (? ā-lup) from the spoon sacrificial butter held forth for the fire, so he who gives not the cow vaçā́ to the priests falls under the wrath of Agni.

verses.sa:
पुरोडाशवत्सा सुदुघा लोकेऽस्मा उप तिष्ठति ।
सास्मै सर्वान् कामान् वशा प्रददुषे दुहे ॥
verses.rom:
purodashavatsa sudugha loke'sma upa tishthati |
sasmai sarvan kaman vasha pradadushe duhe ||
verses.en: With the sacrificial cake as calf, milking well, she draws near to him in the world; she yields (duh) to him all his desires—[namely,] the cow vaçā́ to him who has presented her.

verses.sa:
सर्वान् कामान् यमराज्ये वशा प्रददुषे दुहे ।
अथाहुर्नारकं लोकं निरुन्धानस्य याचिताम् ॥
verses.rom:
sarvan kaman yamarajye vasha pradadushe duhe |
athahurnarakam lokam nirundhanasya yachitam ||
verses.en: All his desires, in Yama's realm, does the cow vaçā́ yield to him who has presented her; likewise they call hell the world of him who keeps her back when asked for.

verses.sa:
प्रवीयमाना चरति क्रुद्धा गोपतये वशा ।
वेहतं मा मन्यमानो मृत्योः पाशेषु बध्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
praviyamana charati kruddha gopataye vasha |
vehatam ma manyamano mrityoh pasheshu badhyatam ||
verses.en: Being impregnated, the cow vaçā́ goes about angry at her master: thinking me barren, let him be bound in the fetters of death.

verses.sa:
यो वेहतं मन्यमानोऽमा च पचते वशाम् ।
अप्यस्य पुत्रान् पौत्रांश्च याचयते बृहस्पतिः ॥
verses.rom:
yo vehatam manyamano'ma cha pachate vasham |
apyasya putran pautramshcha yachayate brihaspatih ||
verses.en: And he who, thinking her barren, cooks the cow vaçā́ at home (amā́)—his sons and sons' sons also does Brihaspati cause to be asked for.}}

verses.sa:
महदेषाव तपति चरन्ती गोषु गौरपि ।
अथो ह गोपतये वशाददुषे विषं दुहे ॥
verses.rom:
mahadeshava tapati charanti goshu gaurapi |
atho ha gopataye vashadadushe visham duhe ||
verses.en: She sends down great heat, going about a cow (gó) among kine; further, to the master who has not given her the cow (vaçā́) milks poison.

verses.sa:
प्रियं पशूनां भवति यद्ब्रह्मभ्यः प्रदीयते ।
अथो वशायास्तत्प्रियं यद्देवत्रा हविः स्यात् ॥
verses.rom:
priyam pashunam bhavati yadbrahmabhyah pradiyate |
atho vashayastatpriyam yaddevatra havih syat ||
verses.en: It is a thing dear to the cattle that she is presented to the priests (brahmán); further, that is a thing dear to the cow vaçā́, that she be an oblation to the gods.

verses.sa:
या वशा उदकल्पयन् देवा यज्ञादुदेत्य ।
तासां विलिप्त्यं भीमामुदाकुरुत नारदः ॥
verses.rom:
ya vasha udakalpayan deva yajnadudetya |
tasam viliptyam bhimamudakuruta naradah ||
verses.en: What cows the gods shaped out (ut-kḷp), rising up from the sacrifice, of them Nārada selected for himself the fearful viliptī́.

verses.sa:
तां देवा अमीमांसन्त वशेया३ अवशेति ।
तामब्रवीन् नारद एषा वशानां वशतमेति ॥
verses.rom:
tam deva amimamsanta vasheya3 avasheti |
tamabravin narada esha vashanam vashatameti ||
verses.en: The gods questioned (mīmāṅs-) about her: is this a cow vaçā́, or not a cow.' Of her Nārada said: she is of cows the most truly cow (vaçátama).

verses.sa:
कति नु वशा नारद यास्त्वं वेत्थ मनुष्यजाः ।
तास्त्वा पृच्छामि विद्वांसं कस्या नाश्नीयादब्राह्मणः ॥
verses.rom:
kati nu vasha narada yastvam vettha manushyajah |
tastva prichchhami vidvamsam kasya nashniyadabrahmanah ||
verses.en: How many, pray (nú), Nārada, are the cows which thou knowest, born among men (manuṣyà-)? those I ask of thee who knowest; of which may a non-Brahman not partake (aç)?

verses.sa:
विलिप्त्या बृहस्पते या च सूतवशा वशा ।
तस्या नाश्नीयादब्राह्मणो य आशंसेत भूत्याम् ॥
verses.rom:
viliptya brihaspate ya cha sutavasha vasha |
tasya nashniyadabrahmano ya ashamseta bhutyam ||
verses.en: The viliptī́, O Brihaspati, and the cow vaçā́ that has given birth to [such] a cow—of that one a non-Brahman who should hope for prosperity (bhū́ti) may not partake.

verses.sa:
नमस्ते अस्तु नारदानुष्ठु विदुषे वशा ।
कतमासां भीमतमा यामदत्त्वा पराभवेत् ॥
verses.rom:
namaste astu naradanushthu vidushe vasha |
katamasam bhimatama yamadattva parabhavet ||
verses.en: Homage be to thee, O Nārada; [be] the cow to him who at once knows it. Which one of them is the most fearful, not having given which, one would perish?

verses.sa:
विलिप्ती या बृहस्पतेऽथो सूतवशा वशा ।
तस्या नाश्नीयादब्राह्मणो य आशंसेत भूत्याम् ॥
verses.rom:
vilipti ya brihaspate'tho sutavasha vasha |
tasya nashniyadabrahmano ya ashamseta bhutyam ||
verses.en: She that is viliptī́, O Brihaspati, further the cow that has given birth to [such] a cow—of that one a non-Brahman who should hope for prosperity may not partake.

verses.sa:
त्रीणि वै वशाजातानि विलिप्ती सूतवशा वशा ।
ताः प्र यच्छेद्ब्रह्मभ्यः सोऽनाव्रस्कः प्रजापतौ ॥
verses.rom:
trini vai vashajatani vilipti sutavasha vasha |
tah pra yachchhedbrahmabhyah so'navraskah prajapatau ||
verses.en: Three verily are the kinds of cow: the vilipti, she that has given birth to [such] a cow, the [simple] cow yagd; these one should present to the priests (brahman), [then] he falls not under the wrath of Prajapati.

verses.sa:
एतद्वो ब्राह्मणा हविरिति मन्वीत याचितः ।
वशां चेदेनं याचेयुर्या भीमाददुषो गृहे ॥
verses.rom:
etadvo brahmana haviriti manvita yachitah |
vasham chedenam yacheyurya bhimadadusho grihe ||
verses.en: This, O Brahmans, is your oblation—so, when asked therefor, should he think, if they should ask of him the cow, which in the house of him who has not given her is fearful.

verses.sa:
देवा वशां पर्यवदन् न नोऽदादिति हीडिताः ।
एताभिर्ऋग्भिर्भेदं तस्माद्वै स पराभवत् ॥
verses.rom:
deva vasham paryavadan na no'daditi hiditah |
etabhirrigbhirbhedam tasmadvai sa parabhavat ||
verses.en: The gods talked about the cow in wrath, saying: he hath not given it to us; with these verses (ṛ́c) [they talked about] Bheda; therefore indeed he perished.

verses.sa:
उतैनां भेदो नाददाद्वशामिन्द्रेण याचितः ।
तस्मात्तं देवा आगसोऽवृश्चन्न् अहमुत्तरे ॥
verses.rom:
utainam bhedo nadadadvashamindrena yachitah |
tasmattam deva agaso'vrishchann ahamuttare ||
verses.en: And Bheda gave her not, when asked by Indra for the cow vaçā́; for that offense the gods cut him off in the contest for superiority.

verses.sa:
ये वशाया अदानाय वदन्ति परिरापिणः ।
इन्द्रस्य मन्यवे जाल्मा आ वृश्चन्ते अचित्त्या ॥
verses.rom:
ye vashaya adanaya vadanti parirapinah |
indrasya manyave jalma a vrishchante achittya ||
verses.en: They who, wheedling, advise (vad) to the non-giving of the cow vaçā́, the villains fall under the fury of Indra through ignorance.

verses.sa:
ये गोपतिं पराणीयाथाहुर्मा ददा इति ।
रुद्रस्यास्तां ते हेतीं परि यन्त्यचित्त्या ॥
verses.rom:
ye gopatim paraniyathahurma dada iti |
rudrasyastam te hetim pari yantyachittya ||
verses.en: They who, leading away her master, then say: do not give—they, through ignorance, go to meet the hurled missile of Rudra.

verses.sa:
यदि हुतां यद्यहुताममा च पचते वशाम् ।
देवान्त्सब्राह्मणान् ऋत्वा जिह्मो लोकान् निर्ऋच्छति ॥
verses.rom:
yadi hutam yadyahutamama cha pachate vasham |
devantsabrahmanan ritva jihmo lokan nirrichchhati ||
verses.en: If as offered (hu) and if as unoffered one cooks the cow vaçā́ in private (amā́), coming into collision with the gods accompanied by the Brahmans, he goes supine (jihmá) out of the world.

verses.sa: श्रमेण तपसा सृष्टा ब्रह्मणा वित्तर्ते श्रिता ॥
verses.rom: shramena tapasa srishta brahmana vittarte shrita ||
verses.en: By toil, by penance [is she] created, acquired by bráhman, supported (çritá) on righteousness.

verses.sa: सत्येनावृता श्रिया प्रावृता यशसा परीवृता ॥
verses.rom: satyenavrita shriya pravrita yashasa parivrita ||
verses.en: Covered with truth, enclosed with fortune, enveloped with glory.

verses.sa: स्वधया परिहिता श्रद्धया पर्यूढा दीक्षया गुप्ता यज्ञे प्रतिष्ठिता लोको निधनम् ॥
verses.rom: svadhaya parihita shraddhaya paryudha dikshaya gupta yajne pratishthita loko nidhanam ||
verses.en: Set about with svadhā́, surrounded with faith, guarded by consecration, standing firm in the offering, the world her post (nidhána).

verses.sa: ब्रह्म पदवायं ब्राह्मणोऽधिपतिः ॥
verses.rom: brahma padavayam brahmano'dhipatih ||
verses.en: Bráhman her guide, the Brahman her over-lord.

verses.sa: तामाददानस्य ब्रह्मगवीं जिनतो ब्राह्मणं क्षत्रियस्य ॥
verses.rom: tamadadanasya brahmagavim jinato brahmanam kshatriyasya ||
verses.en: Of the Kshatriya who takes to himself that Brahman-cow, who scathes the Brahman,—

verses.sa: अप क्रामति सूनृता वीर्यं पुण्या लक्ष्मीः ॥
verses.rom: apa kramati sunrita viryam punya lakshmih ||
verses.en: There departs the happiness (sunṛ́tā), the heroism, the good luck.

verses.sa: ओजश्च तेजश्च सहश्च बलं च वाक्चेन्द्रियं च श्रीश्च धर्मश्च ॥
verses.rom: ojashcha tejashcha sahashcha balam cha vakchendriyam cha shrishcha dharmashcha ||
verses.en: Both force, and brilliancy, and power, and strength, and speech, and sense (indriyá), and fortune, and virtue (dhárma),—

verses.sa: ब्रह्म च क्षत्रं च राष्ट्रं च विशश्च त्विषिश्च यशश्च वर्चश्च द्रविणं च ॥
verses.rom: brahma cha kshatram cha rashtram cha vishashcha tvishishcha yashashcha varchashcha dravinam cha ||
verses.en: And holiness (bráhman), and dominion kṣatrám, and kingdom, and subjects (víças), and brightness (tvíṣi), and glory, and honor, and property,—

verses.sa: आयुश्च रूपं च नाम च कीर्तिश्च प्राणश्चापानश्च चक्षुश्च श्रोत्रं च ॥
verses.rom: ayushcha rupam cha nama cha kirtishcha pranashchapanashcha chakshushcha shrotram cha ||
verses.en: And life-time, and form, and name, and fame, and breath, and expiration, and sight, and hearing,—

verses.sa: पयश्च रसश्चान्नं चान्नाद्यं च र्तं च सत्यं चेष्टं च पूर्तं च प्रजा च पशवश्च ॥
verses.rom: payashcha rasashchannam channadyam cha rtam cha satyam cheshtam cha purtam cha praja cha pashavashcha ||
verses.en: And milk, and sap, and food, and food-eating, and righteousness, and truth, and sacrifice (iṣṭá), and bestowal (pūrtá), and progeny, and cattle:—

verses.sa: तानि सर्वाण्यप क्रामन्ति ब्रह्मगवीमाददानस्य जिनतो ब्राह्मणं क्षत्रियस्य ॥
verses.rom: tani sarvanyapa kramanti brahmagavimadadanasya jinato brahmanam kshatriyasya ||
verses.en: All these depart from the Kshatriya who takes to himself the Brahman-cow, who scathes the Brahman.

verses.sa: सैषा भीमा ब्रह्मगव्यघविषा साक्षात्कृत्या कूल्बजमावृता ॥
verses.rom: saisha bhima brahmagavyaghavisha sakshatkritya kulbajamavrita ||
verses.en: This same Brahman-cow [is] fearful, having deadly poison, witchcraft incarnate (sākṣā́t), kū́lbaja when covered.

verses.sa: सर्वाण्यस्यां घोराणि सर्वे च मृत्यवः ॥
verses.rom: sarvanyasyam ghorani sarve cha mrityavah ||
verses.en: In her are all terrible things and all deaths.

verses.sa: सर्वाण्यस्यां क्रूराणि सर्वे पुरुषवधाः ॥
verses.rom: sarvanyasyam krurani sarve purushavadhah ||
verses.en: In her are all cruel things, all men-killers (puruṣavadhá).

verses.sa: सा ब्रह्मज्यं देवपीयुं ब्रह्मगव्यादीयमाना मृत्योः पड्वीश आ द्यति ॥
verses.rom: sa brahmajyam devapiyum brahmagavyadiyamana mrityoh padvisha a dyati ||
verses.en: This Brahman-cow, when taken to oneself, binds the Brahman-scather, the god-reviler, in the shackle of death.

verses.sa: मेनिः शतवधा हि सा ब्रह्मज्यस्य क्षितिर्हि सा ॥
verses.rom: menih shatavadha hi sa brahmajyasya kshitirhi sa ||
verses.en: Verily (hí) a hundred-killing weapon (mení) is she; verily the destruction of the Brahman-scather is she.

verses.sa: तस्माद्वै ब्राह्मणानां गौर्दुराधर्षा विजानता ॥
verses.rom: tasmadvai brahmananam gaurduradharsha vijanata ||
verses.en: Therefore indeed is the cow of the Brahmans hard to be dared against by one who understands (vi-jñā).*

verses.sa: वज्रो धावन्ती वैश्वानर उद्वीता ॥
verses.rom: vajro dhavanti vaishvanara udvita ||
verses.en: [She is] a thunderbolt when running, Vāiçvānara when driven up (údvīta).

verses.sa: हेतिः शफान् उत्खिदन्ती महादेवोऽपेक्षमाणा ॥
verses.rom: hetih shaphan utkhidanti mahadevo'pekshamana ||
verses.en: A missile when extracting (ut-khid) her hoofs, the great god when looking away.

verses.sa: क्षुरपविरीक्षमाणा वाश्यमानाभि स्फूर्जति ॥
verses.rom: kshurapavirikshamana vashyamanabhi sphurjati ||
verses.en: Keen-edged (kṣurápavi) when looking; when bellowing, she thunders at one.

verses.sa: मृत्युर्हिङ्कृण्वत्युग्रो देवः पुच्छं पर्यस्यन्ती ॥
verses.rom: mrityurhinkrinvatyugro devah puchchham paryasyanti ||
verses.en: Death when uttering hing; the formidable god when slinging about her tail.

verses.sa: सर्वज्यानिः कर्णौ वरीवर्जयन्ती राजयक्ष्मो मेहन्ती ॥
verses.rom: sarvajyanih karnau varivarjayanti rajayakshmo mehanti ||
verses.en: Total scathing when twisting about her ears; king-yákṣma when urinating.

verses.sa: मेनिर्दुह्यमाना शीर्षक्तिर्दुग्धा ॥
verses.rom: menirduhyamana shirshaktirdugdha ||
verses.en: A weapon (mení) when being milked; headache when milked.

verses.sa: सेदिरुपतिष्ठन्ती मिथोयोधः परामृष्टा ॥
verses.rom: sedirupatishthanti mithoyodhah paramrishta ||
verses.en: Debility when approaching (upa-sthā); mutual strife when felt of.

verses.sa: शरव्या मुखेऽपिनह्यमान ऋतिर्हन्यमाना ॥
verses.rom: sharavya mukhe'pinahyamana ritirhanyamana ||
verses.en: A shaft when her mouth is being fastened up; mishap (ṛ́ti) when being slain.

verses.sa: अघविषा निपतन्ती तमो निपतिता ॥
verses.rom: aghavisha nipatanti tamo nipatita ||
verses.en: Deadly poisonous when falling down; darkness when fallen down.

verses.sa: अनुगच्छन्ती प्राणान् उप दासयति ब्रह्मगवी ब्रह्मज्यस्य ॥
verses.rom: anugachchhanti pranan upa dasayati brahmagavi brahmajyasya ||
verses.en: Going after him, the Brahman-cow exhausts the breaths of the Brahman-scather.

verses.sa: वैरं विकृत्यमाना पौत्राद्यं विभाज्यमाना ॥
verses.rom: vairam vikrityamana pautradyam vibhajyamana ||
verses.en: [She is] hostility when being cut up, the eating of one's children when being shared out.

verses.sa: देवहेतिर्ह्रियमाणा व्यृद्धिर्हृता ॥
verses.rom: devahetirhriyamana vyriddhirhrita ||
verses.en: A gods' missile when being taken, failure when taken.

verses.sa: पाप्माधिधीयमाना पारुष्यमवधीयमाना ॥
verses.rom: papmadhidhiyamana parushyamavadhiyamana ||
verses.en: Evil when being set on, harshness when being set down.

verses.sa: विषं प्रयस्यन्ती तक्मा प्रयस्ता ॥
verses.rom: visham prayasyanti takma prayasta ||
verses.en: Poison when heating (? pra-yas), takmán when heated.

verses.sa: अघं प्रच्यमाना दुष्वप्न्यं पक्वा ॥
verses.rom: agham prachyamana dushvapnyam pakva ||
verses.en: Evil (aghá) when being cooked, bad dreaming when cooked.

verses.sa: मूलबर्हणी पर्याक्रियमाणा क्षितिः पर्याकृता ॥
verses.rom: mulabarhani paryakriyamana kshitih paryakrita ||
verses.en: Uprooting when being turned about (? pari-ā-kṛ), destruction when turned about.

verses.sa: असंज्ञा गन्धेन शुगुद्ध्रियमाणाशीविष उद्धृता ॥
verses.rom: asamjna gandhena shuguddhriyamanashivisha uddhrita ||
verses.en: Discord by smell; pain (çúc) when being taken up, a poison-snake when taken up.

verses.sa: अभूतिरुपह्रियमाणा पराभूतिरुपहृता ॥
verses.rom: abhutirupahriyamana parabhutirupahrita ||
verses.en: Non-prosperity when being served up, disaster when served up.

verses.sa: शर्वः क्रुद्धः पिश्यमाना शिमिदा पिशिता ॥
verses.rom: sharvah kruddhah pishyamana shimida pishita ||
verses.en: Çarva angered when being dressed (piç), Çimidā when dressed.

verses.sa: अवर्तिरश्यमाना निर्ऋतिरशिता ॥
verses.rom: avartirashyamana nirritirashita ||
verses.en: Ruin when being partaken of, perdition when partaken of.

verses.sa: अशिता लोकाच्छिनत्ति ब्रह्मगवी ब्रह्मज्यमस्माच्चामुष्माच्च ॥
verses.rom: ashita lokachchhinatti brahmagavi brahmajyamasmachchamushmachcha ||
verses.en: When partaken of, the Brahman-cow cuts off the Brahman-scather from the world, from both this one and the one yonder.

verses.sa: तस्या आहननं कृत्या मेनिराशसनं वलग ऊबध्यम् ॥
verses.rom: tasya ahananam kritya menirashasanam valaga ubadhyam ||
verses.en: The slaying of her is witchcraft, her cutting up (āçásana) is a weapon (mení), the contents of her bowels a secret charm.

verses.sa: अस्वगता परिह्णुता ॥
verses.rom: asvagata parihnuta ||
verses.en: [She is] homelessness when hidden (? pari-hnu).

verses.sa: अग्निः क्रव्याद्भूत्वा ब्रह्मगवी ब्रह्मज्यं प्रविश्यात्ति ॥
verses.rom: agnih kravyadbhutva brahmagavi brahmajyam pravishyatti ||
verses.en: The Brahman-cow, having become the flesh-eating Agni, entering into the Brahman-scather, eats him.

verses.sa: सर्वास्याङ्गा पर्वा मूलानि वृश्चति ॥
verses.rom: sarvasyanga parva mulani vrishchati ||
verses.en: All his limbs, joints, roots, she cuts off (vraçc).

verses.sa: छिनत्त्यस्य पितृबन्धु परा भावयति मातृबन्धु ॥
verses.rom: chhinattyasya pitribandhu para bhavayati matribandhu ||
verses.en: She severs (chid) his paternal connection, makes perish his maternal connection.

verses.sa: विवाहां ज्ञातीन्त्सर्वान् अपि क्षापयति ब्रह्मगवी ब्रह्मज्यस्य क्षत्रियेणापुनर्दीयमाना ॥
verses.rom: vivaham jnatintsarvan api kshapayati brahmagavi brahmajyasya kshatriyenapunardiyamana ||
verses.en: All the marriages, acquaintances of the Brahman-scather does the Brahman-cow scorch (? api-kṣā), when not given back by a Kshatriya.

verses.sa: अवास्तुमेनमस्वगमप्रजसं करोत्यपरापरणो भवति क्षीयते ॥
verses.rom: avastumenamasvagamaprajasam karotyaparaparano bhavati kshiyate ||
verses.en: Without abode, without home, without progeny, she makes him; he becomes without succession (?); he is destroyed:—

verses.sa: य एवं विदुषो ब्राह्मणस्य क्षत्रियो गामादत्ते ॥
verses.rom: ya evam vidusho brahmanasya kshatriyo gamadatte ||
verses.en: Whatever Kshatriya takes to himself the cow of a Brahman who knoweth thus.

verses.sa: क्षिप्रं वै तस्याहनने गृध्राः कुर्वत ऐलबम् ॥
verses.rom: kshipram vai tasyahanane gridhrah kurvata ailabam ||
verses.en: Quickly, indeed, at his killing the vultures make a din (āilabá).

verses.sa: क्षिप्रं वै तस्यादहनं परि नृत्यन्ति केशिनीराघ्नानाः पाणिनोरसि कुर्वाणाः पापमैलबम् ॥
verses.rom: kshipram vai tasyadahanam pari nrityanti keshiniraghnanah paninorasi kurvanah papamailabam ||
verses.en: Quickly, indeed, about his place of burning dance the long-haired women, beating on the breast with the hand, making an evil din.

verses.sa: क्षिप्रं वै तस्य वास्तुषु वृकाः कुर्वत ऐलबम् ॥
verses.rom: kshipram vai tasya vastushu vrikah kurvata ailabam ||
verses.en: Quickly, indeed, in his abodes do the wolves make a din.

verses.sa: क्षिप्रं वै तस्य पृच्छन्ति यत्तदासी३ इदं नु ता३ इति ॥
verses.rom: kshipram vai tasya prichchhanti yattadasi3 idam nu ta3 iti ||
verses.en: Quickly, indeed, they ask about him: what that was, is this now that?

verses.sa: छिन्ध्या छिन्धि प्र छिन्ध्यपि क्षापय क्षापय ॥
verses.rom: chhindhya chhindhi pra chhindhyapi kshapaya kshapaya ||
verses.en: Cut thou, cut on, cut forth, scorch, burn (kṣā).

verses.sa: आददानमाङ्गिरसि ब्रह्मज्यमुप दासय ॥
verses.rom: adadanamangirasi brahmajyamupa dasaya ||
verses.en: O daughter of An̄giras, exhaust thou the Brahman-scather, that takes to himself [the cow].

verses.sa: वैश्वदेवी ह्युच्यसे कृत्या कूल्बजमावृता ॥
verses.rom: vaishvadevi hyuchyase kritya kulbajamavrita ||
verses.en: For thou art called belonging to all the gods, witchcraft, kū́lbaja when covered.

verses.sa: ओषन्ती समोषन्ती ब्रह्मणो वज्रः ॥
verses.rom: oshanti samoshanti brahmano vajrah ||
verses.en: Burning (uṣ), consuming, thunderbolt of the brahman.

verses.sa: क्षुरपविर्मृत्युर्भूत्वा वि धाव त्वम् ॥
verses.rom: kshurapavirmrityurbhutva vi dhava tvam ||
verses.en: Having become a keen-edged death, run thou out.

verses.sa: आ दत्से जिनतां वर्च इष्टं पूर्तं चाशिषः ॥
verses.rom: a datse jinatam varcha ishtam purtam chashishah ||
verses.en: Thou takest to thyself the honor of the scathers, their sacrifice and bestowal, their expectations.

verses.sa: आदाय जीतं जीताय लोकेऽमुष्मिन् प्र यच्छसि ॥
verses.rom: adaya jitam jitaya loke'mushmin pra yachchhasi ||
verses.en: Taking to thyself what is scathed for him who is scathed, thou presentest [it to him] in yonder world.

verses.sa: अघ्न्ये पदवीर्भव ब्राह्मणस्याभिशस्त्या ॥
verses.rom: aghnye padavirbhava brahmanasyabhishastya ||
verses.en: O inviolable one, become thou the guide of the Brahman out of imprecation.

verses.sa: मेनिः शरव्या भवाघादघविषा भव ॥
verses.rom: menih sharavya bhavaghadaghavisha bhava ||
verses.en: Become thou a weapon (mení), a shaft; become thou deadly poisonous from evil (aghá).

verses.sa: अघ्न्ये प्र शिरो जहि ब्रह्मज्यस्य कृतागसो देवपीयोरराधसः ॥
verses.rom: aghnye pra shiro jahi brahmajyasya kritagaso devapiyoraradhasah ||
verses.en: O inviolable one, smite forth the head of the Brahman-scather that has committed offense, of the god-reviler, the ungenerous.

verses.sa: त्वया प्रमूर्णं मृदितमग्निर्दहतु दुश्चितम् ॥
verses.rom: tvaya pramurnam mriditamagnirdahatu dushchitam ||
verses.en: Let Agni burn the malevolent one, slaughtered, crushed (mṛd) by thee.

verses.sa: वृश्च प्र वृश्च सं वृश्च दह प्र दह सं दह ॥
verses.rom: vrishcha pra vrishcha sam vrishcha daha pra daha sam daha ||
verses.en: Cut (vraçc) thou, cut off, cut up; burn thou, burn off, burn up.

verses.sa: ब्रह्मज्यं देव्यघ्न्य आ मूलादनुसंदह ॥
verses.rom: brahmajyam devyaghnya a muladanusamdaha ||
verses.en: The Brahman-scather, O divine inviolable one, do thou burn up all the way from the root.

verses.sa: यथायाद्यमसादनात्पापलोकान् परावतः ॥
verses.rom: yathayadyamasadanatpapalokan paravatah ||
verses.en: That he may go from Yama's seat to evil worlds, to the distances.

verses.sa: एवा त्वं देव्यघ्न्ये ब्रह्मज्यस्य कृतागसो देवपीयोरराधसः ॥
verses.rom: eva tvam devyaghnye brahmajyasya kritagaso devapiyoraradhasah ||
verses.en: So do thou, O divine inviolable one, of the Brahman-scather that has committed offense, of the god-reviler, the ungenerous,—

verses.sa: वज्रेण शतपर्वणा तीक्ष्णेन क्षुरभृष्टिना ॥
verses.rom: vajrena shataparvana tikshnena kshurabhrishtina ||
verses.en: With a thunderbolt hundred-jointed, sharp, razor-pronged,—

verses.sa: प्र स्कन्धान् प्र शिरो जहि ॥
verses.rom: pra skandhan pra shiro jahi ||
verses.en: Smite forth the shoulder-bones, forth the head.

verses.sa: लोमान्यस्य सं छिन्धि त्वचमस्य वि वेष्टय ॥
verses.rom: lomanyasya sam chhindhi tvachamasya vi veshtaya ||
verses.en: His hairs (lóman) do thou cut up (sam-chid); his skin strip off;—

verses.sa: मांसान्यस्य शातय स्नावान्यस्य सं वृह ॥
verses.rom: mamsanyasya shataya snavanyasya sam vriha ||
verses.en: His flesh cut in pieces; his sinews wrench off;—

verses.sa: अस्थीन्यस्य पीडय मज्जानमस्य निर्जहि ॥
verses.rom: asthinyasya pidaya majjanamasya nirjahi ||
verses.en: His bones distress (pīḍ); his marrow smite out;—

verses.sa: सर्वास्याङ्गा पर्वाणि वि श्रथय ॥
verses.rom: sarvasyanga parvani vi shrathaya ||
verses.en: All his limbs, [his] joints unloosen.

verses.sa: अग्निरेनं क्रव्यात्पृथिव्या नुदतामुदोषतु वायुरन्तरिक्षान् महतो वरिम्णः ॥
verses.rom: agnirenam kravyatprithivya nudatamudoshatu vayurantarikshan mahato varimnah ||
verses.en: Let the flesh-eating Agni thrust him from the earth, burn (uṣ) up; let Vāyu [do so] from the atmosphere, the great expanse (varimán);—

verses.sa: सूर्य एनं दिवः प्र णुदतां न्योषतु ॥
verses.rom: surya enam divah pra nudatam nyoshatu ||
verses.en: Let the sun thrust him forth from the sky, burn him down.
